            $url = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/' . $this->model . ':generateContent';
            $payload = [
                'systemInstruction' => ['parts' => [['text' => $instruction]]],
                'contents' => [['role' => 'user', 'parts' => [[
                    'text' => json_encode($context, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
                ]]]],
                'generationConfig' => [
                    'responseMimeType' => 'application/json',
                    'candidateCount' => 1,
                    'temperature' => 0.3,
                    'maxOutputTokens' => $maxTokens,
                ],
            ];
            try {
                $response = $this->transport !== null
                    ? ($this->transport)($url, $payload)
                    : $this->post($url, $payload);
            } catch (AIUnavailableException $exception) {
                throw $exception;
            } catch (Throwable) {
                throw self::failure('transport');
            }
            if (($response['curl_error'] ?? 0) !== 0) {
                throw self::failure('transport', $response['status'], curlError: $response['curl_error']);
            }
            return self::parseResponse($response['status'], $response['body']);
        } catch (AIUnavailableException $exception) {
            throw $exception->withStage($stage);
        } catch (JsonException) {
            throw self::failure('configuration', reason: 'REQUEST_ENCODING_FAILED')->withStage($stage);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            // Discard underlying exception text: transport and payloads may contain private data.
            throw self::failure('invalid_output', reason: 'INVALID_ENVELOPE')->withStage($stage);
        }
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $payload @return array{status: int, body: string} */
    private function post(string $url, array $payload): array
    {
        if (!function_exists('curl_init')) {
            throw self::failure('configuration', reason: 'CURL_UNAVAILABLE');
        }
        $handle = curl_init($url);
        if ($handle === false) {
            throw self::failure('transport', reason: 'TRANSPORT_INITIALIZATION_FAILED');
        }
        $body = '';
        $tooLarge = false;
        try {
            curl_setopt_array($handle, [
                CURLOPT_POST => true,
                CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode($payload, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
                CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['x-goog-api-key: ' . $this->apiKey, 'Content-Type: application/json', 'Accept: application/json'],
                CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 3,
                CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 12,
                CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
                CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS => CURLPROTO_HTTPS,
                CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
                CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2,
                CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION => static function ($curl, string $chunk) use (&$body, &$tooLarge): int {
                    if (strlen($body) + strlen($chunk) > self::MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
                        $tooLarge = true;
                        return 0;
                    }
                    $body .= $chunk;
                    return strlen($chunk);
                },
            ]);
            $success = curl_exec($handle);
            $status = (int) curl_getinfo($handle, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            $error = curl_errno($handle);
            if ($tooLarge) {
                throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE', curlError: $error);
            }
            if ($success === false || $error !== 0) {
                throw self::failure('transport', $status, curlError: $error);
            }
            return ['status' => $status, 'body' => $body];
        } finally {
            curl_close($handle);
        }
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public static function parseResponse(int $status, string $body): array
    {
        if ($status < 200 || $status >= 300) {
            throw self::httpFailure($status, $body);
        }
        try {
            if (strlen($body) > self::MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
                throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE');
            }
            $envelope = json_decode($body, true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (!is_array($envelope) || isset($envelope['error'])) {
                throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'INVALID_ENVELOPE');
            }
            if (isset($envelope['promptFeedback']['blockReason'])) {
                throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'BLOCKED_OUTPUT');
            }
            $candidate = $envelope['candidates'][0] ?? null;
            if (!is_array($candidate) || ($candidate['finishReason'] ?? null) !== 'STOP') {
                $reason = is_array($candidate) && in_array($candidate['finishReason'] ?? null, ['SAFETY', 'RECITATION', 'BLOCKLIST', 'PROHIBITED_CONTENT', 'SPII'], true)
                    ? 'BLOCKED_OUTPUT' : 'INCOMPLETE_OUTPUT';
                throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, $reason);
            }
            $parts = $candidate['content']['parts'] ?? null;
            if (!is_array($parts) || $parts === []) {
                throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'MISSING_TEXT');
            }
            $text = '';
            foreach ($parts as $part) {
                if (!is_array($part)) {
                    throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'MISSING_TEXT');
                }
                if (($part['thought'] ?? false) === true) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!isset($part['text']) || !is_string($part['text'])) {
                    throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'MISSING_TEXT');
                }
                $text .= $part['text'];
            }
            // JSON mode is requested; do not salvage fenced, truncated, or free-form output.
            if (!(json_decode($text, false, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) instanceof stdClass)) {
                throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'INVALID_JSON_OBJECT');
            }
            return json_decode($text, true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (AIUnavailableException $exception) {
            throw $exception;
        } catch (Throwable) {
            throw self::failure('invalid_output', $status, 'MALFORMED_JSON');
        }
    }

    private static function httpFailure(int $status, string $body): AIUnavailableException
    {
        // Never classify by free-form message text. Extract only exact known enum values.
        $code = null;
        $reason = null;
        if (strlen($body) <= self::MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
            $envelope = json_decode($body, true, 32);
            $error = is_array($envelope) ? ($envelope['error'] ?? null) : null;
            if (is_array($error)) {
                if (in_array($error['status'] ?? null, AIUnavailableException::PROVIDER_CODES, true)) {
                    $code = $error['status'];
                }
                $details = $error['details'] ?? [];
                if (is_array($details)) {
                    foreach ($details as $detail) {
                        if (is_array($detail) && ($detail['@type'] ?? null) === 'type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo'
                            && in_array($detail['reason'] ?? null, [
                                'API_KEY_INVALID', 'API_KEY_EXPIRED', 'API_KEY_SERVICE_BLOCKED',
                                'API_KEY_HTTP_REFERRER_BLOCKED', 'API_KEY_IP_ADDRESS_BLOCKED',
                                'API_KEY_ANDROID_APP_BLOCKED', 'API_KEY_IOS_APP_BLOCKED',
                                'SERVICE_DISABLED', 'BILLING_DISABLED', 'CONSUMER_INVALID',
                            ], true)) {
                            $reason = $detail['reason'];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        $category = match (true) {
            $status <= 0 => 'transport',
            $status >= 500 => 'provider_unavailable',
            $status === 429 => 'quota_or_rate_limit',
            $status === 401 => 'authentication',
            $status === 404 => 'model_unavailable',
            in_array($reason, ['API_KEY_INVALID', 'API_KEY_EXPIRED'], true) => 'authentication',
            $code === 'UNAUTHENTICATED' => 'authentication',
            in_array($reason, ['API_KEY_SERVICE_BLOCKED', 'API_KEY_HTTP_REFERRER_BLOCKED',
                'API_KEY_IP_ADDRESS_BLOCKED', 'API_KEY_ANDROID_APP_BLOCKED', 'API_KEY_IOS_APP_BLOCKED',
                'SERVICE_DISABLED', 'BILLING_DISABLED', 'CONSUMER_INVALID'], true) => 'authorization',
            $status === 403 => 'authorization',
            default => 'invalid_request',
        };
        return self::failure($category, $status, $reason, $code);
    }

    private static function failure(
        string $category,
        ?int $status = null,
        ?string $reason = null,
        ?string $providerCode = null,
        ?int $curlError = null,
    ): AIUnavailableException {
        return new AIUnavailableException('AI provider request failed.', [
            'provider' => 'gemini',
            'category' => $category,
            'upstream_http_status' => $status,
            'reason' => $reason,
            'provider_code' => $providerCode,
            'curl_error_code' => $curlError,
        ]);
    }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace JobReady\Storage;

use PDO;
use RuntimeException;

final class InterviewStore
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PDO $pdo)
    {
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $plan */
    public function create(string $id, string $cv, string $jobDescription, string $role, array $plan): void
    {
        $now = gmdate('c');
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO interviews (id, cv_text, job_description, target_role, plan_json, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :cv, :job, :role, :plan, :status, :created, :updated)');
        $statement->execute([
            'id' => $id,
            'cv' => $cv,
            'job' => $jobDescription,
            'role' => $role,
            'plan' => $this->encode($plan),
            'status' => 'active',
            'created' => $now,
            'updated' => $now,
        ]);
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed>|null */
    public function find(string $id): ?array
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM interviews WHERE id = :id');
        $statement->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $row = $statement->fetch();
        if ($row === false) {
            return null;
        }
        $row['plan'] = $this->decode($row['plan_json']);
        unset($row['plan_json']);
        return $row;
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $arguments @param array<string, mixed> $result */
    public function addDecision(string $interviewId, string $action, array $arguments, string $rationale, array $result): int
    {
        $sequence = $this->nextSequence('interview_decisions', $interviewId);
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO interview_decisions (interview_id, sequence_no, action, arguments_json, rationale, result_json, created_at) VALUES (:interview, :sequence, :action, :arguments, :rationale, :result, :created)');
        $statement->execute([
            'interview' => $interviewId,
            'sequence' => $sequence,
            'action' => $action,
            'arguments' => $this->encode($arguments),
            'rationale' => $rationale,
            'result' => $this->encode($result),
            'created' => gmdate('c'),
        ]);
        $this->touch($interviewId);
        return (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function setCurrentQuestion(string $interviewId, string $question, int $decisionId): void
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE interviews SET current_question = :question, current_question_decision_id = :decision, updated_at = :updated WHERE id = :id AND status = \'active\'');
        $statement->execute(['question' => $question, 'decision' => $decisionId, 'updated' => gmdate('c'), 'id' => $interviewId]);
        if ($statement->rowCount() !== 1) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Interview is not active.');
        }
    }

    public function addAnswer(string $interviewId, string $answer): int
    {
        $interview = $this->find($interviewId);
        if ($interview === null || $interview['status'] !== 'active' || !is_string($interview['current_question']) || $interview['current_question'] === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Interview has no answerable question.');
        }
        $answerNo = (int) $interview['answer_count'] + 1;
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO interview_answers (interview_id, answer_no, question_decision_id, question_text, answer_text, created_at) VALUES (:interview, :answer_no, :decision, :question, :answer, :created)');
        $statement->execute([
            'interview' => $interviewId,
            'answer_no' => $answerNo,
            'decision' => $interview['current_question_decision_id'],
            'question' => $interview['current_question'],
            'answer' => $answer,
            'created' => gmdate('c'),
        ]);
        $id = (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();
        $update = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE interviews SET answer_count = :count, current_question = NULL, current_question_decision_id = NULL, updated_at = :updated WHERE id = :id');
        $update->execute(['count' => $answerNo, 'updated' => gmdate('c'), 'id' => $interviewId]);
        return $id;
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $evaluation */
    public function addEvaluation(string $interviewId, ?int $answerId, string $type, array $evaluation): void
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO interview_evaluations (interview_id, answer_id, evaluation_type, data_json, created_at) VALUES (:interview, :answer, :type, :data, :created)');
        $statement->execute(['interview' => $interviewId, 'answer' => $answerId, 'type' => $type, 'data' => $this->encode($evaluation), 'created' => gmdate('c')]);
        $this->touch($interviewId);
    }

    public function finish(string $interviewId): void
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE interviews SET status = 'finished', current_question = NULL, current_question_decision_id = NULL, updated_at = :updated WHERE id = :id");
        $statement->execute(['updated' => gmdate('c'), 'id' => $interviewId]);
    }

    /** @return list<array<string, mixed>> */
    public function getAnswers(string $interviewId): array
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id, answer_no, question_text, answer_text, created_at FROM interview_answers WHERE interview_id = :id ORDER BY answer_no');
        $statement->execute(['id' => $interviewId]);
        return $statement->fetchAll();
    }

    /** @return list<array<string, mixed>> */
    public function getDecisions(string $interviewId): array
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT sequence_no, action, arguments_json, rationale, result_json, created_at FROM interview_decisions WHERE interview_id = :id ORDER BY sequence_no');
        $statement->execute(['id' => $interviewId]);
        return array_map(function (array $row): array {
            $row['arguments'] = $this->decode($row['arguments_json']);
            $row['result'] = $this->decode($row['result_json']);
            unset($row['arguments_json'], $row['result_json']);
            return $row;
        }, $statement->fetchAll());
    }

    /** @return list<array<string, mixed>> */
    public function getEvaluations(string $interviewId): array
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT evaluation_type, data_json, created_at FROM interview_evaluations WHERE interview_id = :id ORDER BY id');
        $statement->execute(['id' => $interviewId]);
        return array_map(function (array $row): array {
            $row['data'] = $this->decode($row['data_json']);
            unset($row['data_json']);
            return $row;
        }, $statement->fetchAll());
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed>|null */
    public function getLatestAnswer(string $interviewId): ?array
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id, answer_no, question_text, answer_text FROM interview_answers WHERE interview_id = :id ORDER BY answer_no DESC LIMIT 1');
        $statement->execute(['id' => $interviewId]);
        $row = $statement->fetch();
        return $row === false ? null : $row;
    }

    private function nextSequence(string $table, string $interviewId): int
    {
        if (!in_array($table, ['interview_decisions'], true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid sequence table.');
        }
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) + 1 FROM ' . $table . ' WHERE interview_id = :id');
        $statement->execute(['id' => $interviewId]);
        return (int) $statement->fetchColumn();
    }

    private function touch(string $id): void
    {
        $statement = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE interviews SET updated_at = :updated WHERE id = :id');
        $statement->execute(['updated' => gmdate('c'), 'id' => $id]);
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $value */
    private function encode(array $value): string
    {
        return json_encode($value, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    private function decode(string $json): array
    {
        $value = json_decode($json, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        return is_array($value) ? $value : [];
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace JobReady\Storage;

use PDO;
use RuntimeException;

final class Database
{
    public static function connect(string $databasePath): PDO
    {
        $directory = dirname($databasePath);
        if (!is_dir($directory) && !mkdir($directory, 0700, true) && !is_dir($directory)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to create the SQLite data directory.');
        }

        $pdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $databasePath, null, null, [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
        ]);
        $pdo->exec('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
        $pdo->exec('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');
        $pdo->exec('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000');
        self::initialize($pdo);
        return $pdo;
    }

    public static function initialize(PDO $pdo): void
    {
        $pdo->exec(<<<'SQL'
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interview_sessions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                state_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )
            SQL);
        $pdo->exec(<<<'SQL'
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interviews (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                cv_text TEXT NOT NULL,
                job_description TEXT NOT NULL,
                target_role TEXT NOT NULL,
                plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'finished')),
                answer_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                current_question TEXT,
                current_question_decision_id INTEGER,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )
            SQL);
        $pdo->exec(<<<'SQL'
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interview_decisions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                interview_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES interviews(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
                action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('ask_question', 'probe_answer', 'verify_claim', 'finish_interview')),
                arguments_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
                result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE (interview_id, sequence_no)
            )
            SQL);
        $pdo->exec(<<<'SQL'
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interview_answers (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                interview_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES interviews(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                answer_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
                question_decision_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES interview_decisions(id),
                question_text TEXT NOT NULL,
                answer_text TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE (interview_id, answer_no)
            )
            SQL);
        $pdo->exec(<<<'SQL'
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interview_evaluations (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                interview_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES interviews(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                answer_id INTEGER REFERENCES interview_answers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                evaluation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                data_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )
            SQL);
    }
}

1: // Small, dependency-free boundary around the existing PHP JSON contract.
2: export const LIMITS = Object.freeze({ target_role: 200, cv_text: 20000, job_description: 16000, answer: 8000 });
3: export const uuidPattern = /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i;
4: const text = value => typeof value === 'string' ? value : '';
5: const record = value => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
6: export const byteLength = value => new TextEncoder().encode(value).length;
7: 
8: export class ApiError extends Error {
9:   constructor(message, kind, status = null) {
10:     super(message);
11:     this.name = 'ApiError';
12:     this.kind = kind;
13:     this.status = status;
14:   }
15: }
16: 
17: export function validatePreparation(input) {
18:   const fields = [
19:     ['target_role', 'Target role', 2], ['cv_text', 'CV text', 30], ['job_description', 'Job description', 30],
20:   ];
21:   const result = {};
22:   for (const [key, label, minimum] of fields) {
23:     const value = text(input[key]);
24:     if (byteLength(value.trim()) < minimum) throw new ApiError(`${label} needs a little more detail.`, 'validation');
25:     if (byteLength(value) > LIMITS[key]) throw new ApiError(`${label} exceeds the ${LIMITS[key].toLocaleString('en-US')}-byte limit. Please shorten it.`, 'validation');
26:     result[key] = value.trim();
27:   }
28:   return result;
29: }
30: 
31: export function validateAnswer(value) {
32:   if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) throw new ApiError('Write an answer before submitting.', 'validation');
33:   if (byteLength(value) > LIMITS.answer) throw new ApiError('Your answer exceeds the 8,000-byte limit. Please shorten it.', 'validation');
34:   return value.trim();
35: }
36: 
37: export function parseSession(data) {
38:   // A malformed success response must not clear drafts or advance the UI.
39:   if (!record(data) || !uuidPattern.test(data.id) || !['active', 'finished'].includes(data.status)
40:     || !Number.isInteger(data.answer_count) || data.answer_count < 0
41:     || !record(data.plan) || !Array.isArray(data.plan.focus_areas)
42:     || !data.plan.focus_areas.every(value => typeof value === 'string')
43:     || !Array.isArray(data.answers) || !Array.isArray(data.decisions) || !Array.isArray(data.evaluations)
44:     || (data.status === 'active' && (typeof data.current_question !== 'string' || !data.current_question.trim()))) {
45:     throw new ApiError('The server returned an unexpected session response. Refresh progress before submitting again.', 'response');
46:   }
47:   return {
48:     id: data.id,
49:     target_role: text(data.target_role),
50:     status: data.status,
51:     answer_count: data.answer_count,
52:     current_question: data.status === 'finished' ? null : data.current_question,
53:     plan: { focus_areas: [...data.plan.focus_areas], rationale: text(data.plan.rationale), suggested_depth: text(data.plan.suggested_depth) },
54:     answers: data.answers.filter(record).map(answer => ({
55:       id: answer.id, answer_no: answer.answer_no, question_text: text(answer.question_text), answer_text: text(answer.answer_text),
56:     })),
57:     decisions: data.decisions.filter(record).map(decision => ({
58:       sequence_no: decision.sequence_no, action: text(decision.action), rationale: text(decision.rationale),
59:       arguments: record(decision.arguments) ? { ...decision.arguments } : {},
60:       result: record(decision.result) ? { ...decision.result } : {},
61:     })),
62:     evaluations: data.evaluations.filter(record).map(evaluation => ({
63:       evaluation_type: text(evaluation.evaluation_type), data: record(evaluation.data) ? { ...evaluation.data } : {},
64:     })),
65:   };
66: }
67: 
68: export function currentQuestionDecision(session) {
69:   return [...session.decisions].reverse().find(decision => ['ask_question', 'probe_answer'].includes(decision.action)) ?? null;
70: }
71: 
72: export function readinessReport(session) {
73:   const report = [...session.evaluations].reverse().find(evaluation => evaluation.evaluation_type === 'readiness_report');
74:   // The finished decision also carries the same backend report; no client-generated assessment.
75:   const finish = [...session.decisions].reverse().find(decision => decision.action === 'finish_interview');
76:   const data = report?.data ?? finish?.result;
77:   if (!record(data)) return null;
78:   return { summary: text(data.summary), readiness: ['not_ready', 'developing', 'ready'].includes(data.readiness) ? data.readiness : null };
79: }
80: 
81: export function sessionAdvanced(before, after) {
82:   return before.id === after.id && (after.answer_count > before.answer_count
83:     || after.status === 'finished'
84:     || currentQuestionDecision(before)?.sequence_no !== currentQuestionDecision(after)?.sequence_no);
85: }
86: 
87: function errorForStatus(status) {
88:   const messages = {
89:     400: 'The request could not be read. Check your input and try again.',
90:     404: 'This interview could not be found. Check the session ID or start a new session.',
91:     409: 'This session has changed or is no longer awaiting an answer. Refresh progress to continue.',
92:     413: 'Your interview brief is too large. Shorten the text and try again.',
93:     422: 'Some input is missing or outside the allowed limits. Review the fields and try again.',
94:     429: 'The service is busy. Wait a moment before trying again.',
95:     502: 'Your coach returned a response that could not be validated. Your draft is still here.',
96:     503: 'The AI interview service is temporarily unavailable. Your draft is still here.',
97:   };
98:   return new ApiError(messages[status] ?? 'The request could not be completed. Your draft is still here.', 'http', status);
99: }
100: 
101: export function createInterviewApi(fetchRequest = globalThis.fetch, timeoutMs = 90000) {
102:   async function request(path, method = 'GET', payload) {
103:     const controller = new AbortController();
104:     const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
105:     try {
106:       const response = await fetchRequest(path, {
107:         method, signal: controller.signal, credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error',
108:         headers: { Accept: 'application/json', ...(payload ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}) },
109:         ...(payload ? { body: JSON.stringify(payload) } : {}),
110:       });
111:       // Ignore error response contents/diagnostics entirely; surface only safe local UI messages.
112:       if (!response.ok) throw errorForStatus(response.status);
113:       let data;
114:       try { data = await response.json(); }
115:       catch { throw new ApiError('The server returned an unreadable response. Refresh progress before submitting again.', 'response'); }
116:       return parseSession(data);
117:     } catch (error) {
118:       if (error instanceof ApiError) throw error;
119:       if (controller.signal.aborted) throw new ApiError('The request timed out. It may have reached the server; refresh progress before submitting again.', 'timeout');
120:       throw new ApiError('The connection was interrupted. Your draft is still here. Refresh progress before submitting again.', 'network');
121:     } finally {
122:       clearTimeout(timeout);
123:     }
124:   }
125:   function sessionPath(id) {
126:     if (!uuidPattern.test(id)) throw new ApiError('Enter a valid interview session ID.', 'validation');
127:     return `/api/interviews/${id}`;
128:   }
129:   return {
130:     start: input => request('/api/interviews', 'POST', validatePreparation(input)),
131:     answer: (id, value) => request(`${sessionPath(id)}/answers`, 'POST', { answer: validateAnswer(value) }),
132:     progress: id => request(sessionPath(id)),
133:   };
134: }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace JobReady\Observability;

use Throwable;

final class NeatlogsClient implements NeatlogsClientInterface
{
    private const ENDPOINT = 'https://ingest.neatlogs.com/v1/trace';
    private const CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 2;
    private const TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5;
    private ?array $lastFailureDiagnostic = null;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ?string $writeKey,
        private readonly ?string $project,
    ) {
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $attributes */
    public function recordEvent(string $name, array $attributes = []): bool
    {
        $this->lastFailureDiagnostic = null;
        if ($this->writeKey === null || trim($this->writeKey) === '' || $this->project === null || trim($this->project) === '') {
            return false;
        }
        if (!function_exists('curl_init')) {
            error_log('JobReady neatlogs transport unavailable (cURL extension missing).');
            return false;
        }
        if (preg_match('/[\r\n]/', $this->writeKey) || trim($name) === '') {
            error_log('JobReady neatlogs event skipped (invalid configuration or event name).');
            return false;
        }

        try {
            $trace = ['name' => $name, 'project' => $this->project];
            if ($attributes !== []) {
                $trace['metadata'] = $attributes;
            }
            $payload = json_encode($trace, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
            $handle = curl_init(self::ENDPOINT);
            if ($handle === false) {
                error_log('JobReady neatlogs request could not be initialized.');
                return false;
            }

            curl_setopt_array($handle, [
                CURLOPT_POST => true,
                CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $payload,
                CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
                    'Authorization: Bearer ' . $this->writeKey,
                    'Content-Type: application/json',
                    'Accept: application/json',
                ],
                CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => self::CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => self::TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
                CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS => CURLPROTO_HTTPS,
                CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
                CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2,
                CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            ]);
            $responseBody = curl_exec($handle);
            $status = (int) curl_getinfo($handle, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            $errorNumber = curl_errno($handle);
            curl_close($handle);

            if ($errorNumber !== 0) {
                error_log('JobReady neatlogs request failed (cURL error ' . $errorNumber . ').');
                return false;
            } elseif ($status < 200 || $status >= 300) {
                if ($status === 403) {
                    $this->lastFailureDiagnostic = self::classifyForbiddenResponse(
                        is_string($responseBody) ? $responseBody : '',
                    );
                }
                error_log('JobReady neatlogs request returned HTTP ' . $status . '.');
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            // Observability must never interfere with application behavior. Do not log payloads or credentials.
            error_log('JobReady neatlogs request failed (' . get_class($exception) . ').');
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** @return array{category: string, code: string|null}|null */
    public function getLastFailureDiagnostic(): ?array
    {
        return $this->lastFailureDiagnostic;
    }

    /** @return array{category: string, code: string|null} */
    private static function classifyForbiddenResponse(string $body): array
    {
        // Inspect a bounded JSON response locally; never retain, return, or log its raw contents.
        $decoded = json_decode(substr($body, 0, 16384), true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            return ['category' => 'proxy_or_non_json_rejection', 'code' => null];
        }

        $code = null;
        foreach (['code', 'error_code'] as $key) {
            if (isset($decoded[$key]) && is_string($decoded[$key])) {
                $candidate = strtoupper($decoded[$key]);
                if (preg_match('/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,47}$/', $candidate)) {
                    $code = $candidate;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $descriptors = [];
        foreach (['code', 'error_code', 'error', 'message'] as $key) {
            if (isset($decoded[$key]) && is_string($decoded[$key])) {
                $descriptors[] = strtolower($decoded[$key]);
            }
        }
        $description = implode(' ', $descriptors);

        if (preg_match('/proxy|gateway|firewall|upstream|network|waf|blocked by policy/', $description)) {
            $category = 'proxy_or_network_rejection';
        } elseif (preg_match('/auth|credential|token|permission|forbidden|project_access|unauthorized/', $description)) {
            $category = 'neatlogs_auth_or_authorization';
        } else {
            $category = 'structured_http_403';
        }

        return ['category' => $category, 'code' => $code];
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

use JobReady\Http\HttpException;
use JobReady\Http\ErrorResponse;

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');

function jsonResponse(int $status, array $payload): never
{
    http_response_code($status);
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

try {
    $services = require dirname(__DIR__) . '/config/bootstrap.php';
    $method = strtoupper($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET');
    $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH) ?: '/';
    if ($method === 'POST' && str_starts_with($path, '/api/interviews')) {
        set_time_limit(65);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/') {
        jsonResponse(200, ['status' => 'ok', 'service' => 'JobReady']);
    }

    if ($path === '/api/dev/status') {
        $enabled = in_array($services['environment'], ['local', 'development'], true)
            && $services['debug'] === true;
        if ($method !== 'GET' || !$enabled) {
            throw new HttpException(404, 'Endpoint not found.');
        }
        // Explicit non-secret fields only; never serialize the environment or service container.
        $model = $services['gemini_model'];
        jsonResponse(200, [
            'APP_ENV' => $services['environment'],
            'debug_enabled' => $services['debug'],
            'AI_PROVIDER' => $services['ai_provider'],
            'GEMINI_MODEL' => preg_match('/^gemini-[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{1,100}$/D', $model) === 1 ? $model : null,
            'diagnostics_enabled' => $enabled,
            'sqlite_driver_available' => in_array('sqlite', PDO::getAvailableDrivers(), true),
        ]);
    }

    $contentType = strtolower(trim(explode(';', $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '')[0]));
    $body = null;
    if ($method === 'POST') {
        if ($contentType !== 'application/json') {
            throw new HttpException(415, 'Content-Type must be application/json.');
        }
        $contentLength = (int) ($_SERVER['CONTENT_LENGTH'] ?? 0);
        if ($contentLength > 50000) {
            throw new HttpException(413, 'Request body exceeds the size limit.');
        }
        $raw = file_get_contents('php://input', false, null, 0, 50001);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) > 50000) {
            throw new HttpException(413, 'Request body exceeds the size limit.');
        }
        try {
            $body = json_decode($raw, true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException) {
            throw new HttpException(400, 'Request body must be valid JSON.');
        }
        if (!is_array($body)) {
            throw new HttpException(400, 'Request body must be a JSON object.');
        }
    }

    if ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/api/interviews') {
        jsonResponse(201, $services['interview_service']->start($body));
    }

    if (preg_match('#^/api/interviews/([a-f0-9-]{36})/answers$#i', $path, $matches)) {
        if ($method !== 'POST') {
            throw new HttpException(405, 'Method not allowed.');
        }
        jsonResponse(200, $services['interview_service']->submitAnswer($matches[1], $body['answer'] ?? null));
    }

    if (preg_match('#^/api/interviews/([a-f0-9-]{36})$#i', $path, $matches)) {
        if ($method !== 'GET') {
            throw new HttpException(405, 'Method not allowed.');
        }
        jsonResponse(200, $services['interview_service']->getProgress($matches[1]));
    }

    throw new HttpException(404, 'Endpoint not found.');
} catch (HttpException $exception) {
    jsonResponse($exception->status, ErrorResponse::fromException(
        $exception,
        $services['environment'] ?? 'production',
        ($services['debug'] ?? false) === true,
    ));
} catch (Throwable $exception) {
    error_log('JobReady request failed: ' . get_class($exception));
    jsonResponse(500, ['error' => 'An internal error occurred.']);
}

## Confirmed findings

**The cause of this particular 503 is not identifiable from the available logs. The unchanged Question 5 and four saved answers are consistent with the intended transaction rollback.**

- `InterviewService::submitAnswer()` inserts the answer, runs the agent, and commits **only after the next decision succeeds**. A failure rolls back the answer, count update, and any intermediate decisions/evaluations.
- There is **no special Question 5 boundary**. The configured interview limit is 20 answers.
- Provider failures during `decision` or `claim_verification` become HTTP **503**, with sanitized diagnostics when development mode is enabled.
- Unexpected storage or execution errors inside the transaction also become **503**, but currently receive no diagnostic metadata.
- **The frontend discards the error response body**, including development diagnostics, and displays its own generic 503 message. The backend response may therefore contain useful information that the page does not show.
- The existing offline Gemini test suite passed, including simulated quota/transport failures and rollback recovery.

### Available logs and session evidence
- No repository `.log` files were found.
- The CLI PHP error-log destination is configured, but no readable existing file was available there. The running server’s console history is not accessible through these tools.
- Handled AI failures are not explicitly logged. neatlogs tracing happens **after successful commit**, so failed turns do not receive a failure trace.
- The current port-8000 server’s document root matches this workspace.
- A read-only, metadata-only query did **not** find this interview ID in the default workspace database. The live database may be configured elsewhere; I did not read private configuration or candidate text, so I cannot independently verify its stored state.

## Possible causes—not confirmed

| Cause | Expected sanitized evidence |
|---|---|
| Gemini rate limit or quota exhaustion | `category=quota_or_rate_limit`, upstream HTTP `429` |
| Gemini/provider temporary outage | `category=provider_unavailable`, upstream HTTP `500` or `503` |
| Gemini timeout | `category=transport`, typically cURL error `28`; each provider call has a **12-second timeout** |
| Invalid, blocked, or truncated model output | `category=invalid_output`, often upstream HTTP `200` |
| SQLite contention or another unexpected execution error | Generic turn-processing 503, potentially without diagnostics |

An answer turn can make up to **five Gemini calls** when claim verification is selected. That makes rate limits and latency plausible, but not proven. PHP rejection of an invalid action/tool argument ordinarily returns **502**, while invalid candidate input returns **422**.

## Smallest corrective action

**Inspect the already-failed POST’s Response in the browser Network panel**, if it is still retained. Extract only:

- the generic `error`
- `diagnostics.provider`
- `diagnostics.stage`
- `diagnostics.category`
- `diagnostics.upstream_http_status`
- `diagnostics.curl_error_code`
- any allowlisted `reason`

This requires no resubmission and should distinguish quota, timeout, invalid output, and the generic transaction-error path before changing limits or adding retries. Do not share the request payload, headers, or a HAR export.

No provider requests or answer resubmissions were made. No files, private configuration, or Git state were modified, and no private candidate content was read or displayed.

 # JobReady
 
 An AI-powered adaptive interview preparation agent built for neatHack 2026.
 
 ## What it does
 
 JobReady helps job seekers prepare for interviews using their CV, target job description, and personalised practice sessions.
 
 ## Core features
 
 - Analyse a candidate's CV and job description
 - Generate relevant interview questions
 - Evaluate candidate responses
 - Ask adaptive follow-up questions
 - Track interview progress
 - Produce a personalised readiness report
 
 ## Technology
 
 - PHP 8.2
 - HTML, CSS and JavaScript
 - Gemini API (default), with optional OpenAI provider
 - neatlogs for agent observability
 
 ## Project status

 ## Local setup
 
 Requirements: PHP 8.2 with `PDO`, `pdo_sqlite`, and `curl` enabled. Confirm the modules with `php -m`.
 
 1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and adjust local settings as needed. The example contains placeholders only; credentials belong in `.env` and must not be committed.

    ```sh
    php -S 127.0.0.1:8000 -t public
    ```

 ## Candidate interface
 
 Open **`http://127.0.0.1:8000/app.html`** for the JobReady frontend. It is vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with no build step, external fonts, or frontend dependencies. The existing `/` health endpoint and interview APIs are preserved.

 ```dotenv
 AI_PROVIDER=gemini

 GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash-lite
 ```

The client uses Google's [official REST generateContent API](https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content), with the key in the `x-goog-api-key` header and JSON response mode. The selected model is Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, which has offered free-tier text usage, subject to your account's quota, region, and current [model availability](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models) and [pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing). Failed interview turns roll back and leave the previous question available for retry; there are no automatic provider retries or fallbacks. The existing PHP action/tool validator still determines which decisions can execute. Merely loading bootstrap or the health endpoint makes no AI request; starting an interview or submitting an answer does.

 To diagnose an explicitly approved local AI test, set these non-secret values in your private `.env` yourself and restart the PHP server:

It reports exactly `APP_ENV`, `debug_enabled`, `AI_PROVIDER`, `GEMINI_MODEL`, `diagnostics_enabled`, and `sqlite_driver_available`. Configure `NEATLOGS_WRITE_KEY` and `NEATLOGS_PROJECT` in `.env`; the key is read only by PHP and is never returned to the browser. When either value is absent, tracing is a no-op. Transport and HTTP failures are handled without interrupting JobReady, and error logs contain no token, payload, or response body.
 
 ## Interview API (JSON)
 
 - `POST /api/interviews` — start an individualized session. JSON body: `{"cv_text":"...", "job_description":"...", "target_role":"..."}`. Returns the session ID, generated plan, and first question.
 - `POST /api/interviews/{id}/answers` — submit a response. JSON body: `{"answer":"..."}`. The agent evaluates context and chooses its next action; it may ask a new question, probe the answer, verify a claim against supplied evidence, or finish.
 - `GET /api/interviews/{id}` — retrieve progress, questions, answers, decisions, evaluations, and any current question. CV and job-description fields are not returned.
 
 Requests must use `Content-Type: application/json`. CV text is limited to 20 KB, job descriptions to 16 KB, role names to 200 bytes, answers to 8 KB, and interviews to 20 submitted answers. Agent decisions are bounded to three per API turn.

 ```sh
 php tests/InterviewWorkflowTest.php
 php tests/GeminiClientTest.php
 php tests/GeminiDiagnosticsTest.php
 php tests/DevStatusEndpointTest.php
 php tests/HealthEndpointTest.php
 ```

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require __DIR__ . '/Support/IsolatedHttpServer.php';

$server = new IsolatedHttpServer();
try {
    $page = $server->requestRaw('GET', '/app.html');
    if ($page['status'] !== 200 || !str_starts_with($page['content_type'], 'text/html')
        || !str_contains($page['body'], 'id="preparation-form"')
        || !str_contains($page['body'], 'id="answer-form"')
        || !str_contains($page['body'], 'id="readiness-card"')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Frontend HTML could not be served.');
    }
    foreach (['/assets/app.css', '/assets/app.mjs', '/assets/interview-api.mjs', '/assets/jobready.svg'] as $asset) {
        $response = $server->requestRaw('GET', $asset);
        if ($response['status'] !== 200 || $response['body'] === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Frontend asset could not be served.');
        }
        if (str_ends_with($asset, '.mjs') && !str_contains($response['content_type'], 'javascript')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('JavaScript module MIME type is incorrect.');
        }
    }
    $health = $server->request('GET', '/');
    if ($health['status'] !== 200 || $health['json'] !== ['status' => 'ok', 'service' => 'JobReady']) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Frontend changed the health endpoint.');
    }
    echo "Frontend HTTP asset and unchanged health endpoint tests passed (isolated server).\n";
} finally {
    $server->stop();
}

 The interface includes a preparation brief, adaptive interview workspace, backend-provided focus areas, saved-answer journal, claim evidence reviews when returned, and a completion/readiness report. It distinguishes `probe_answer` follow-ups from new questions. It does not invent evaluation scores, percentage progress, or a fixed question count. All candidate and AI text is rendered with text nodes rather than HTML.
 
-Use **Refresh progress** to load the current saved session, or paste an existing ID into **Already have an interview session?**. Only the session ID is remembered in tab-scoped `sessionStorage`; CVs, job descriptions, answers, and reports are not persisted in browser storage. Treat the ID as private because the backend currently uses it to access the session. Unsaved answer drafts stay in memory. If a failed submission may already have reached the server, refresh is required before another submission; an unsaved draft from a changed question is kept in the interface for reference. There are no automatic POST retries.
+Use **Refresh progress** to load the current saved session, or paste an existing ID into **Already have an interview session?**. The session ID and latest unsent answer draft are remembered in tab-scoped `sessionStorage`; CVs, job descriptions, full answer history, and reports are not persisted in browser storage. Treat the ID as private because the backend currently uses it to access the session. Drafts are bound to the session ID, question decision sequence, and saved-answer count. They survive page reloads in the same tab when browser storage is available, and are cleared once the corresponding saved answer is confirmed or a new session is created. If storage is unavailable, the interface reports that the draft is retained only in memory.
 
+After an uncertain or failed submission, an explicit **Refresh progress** is required before another POST—even after a page reload. Reload restoration performs only a progress GET and never auto-submits a draft. A draft for a changed question is displayed separately for reference rather than inserted into the next answer. There are no automatic POST retries. Existing server sessions and saved answers are not reset by these frontend recovery controls.
+
+Error messages distinguish recognized provider failures such as quota limits, unavailable models, transport failures, and invalid AI output without echoing raw provider messages. A collapsed **Development technical details** section shows only allowlisted category, stage, and upstream HTTP status when the backend supplies development-gated diagnostics. The backend's existing local/development + `APP_DEBUG=true` gate remains authoritative; production responses without metadata do not reveal the section. Credentials, headers, candidate inputs, and raw response bodies are never included. Safe provider/cURL metadata is retained in the frontend error object, not persisted in draft storage.
+
 Controls support keyboard navigation, visible focus, labeled inputs, status announcements, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter for answer submission. The layout adapts to desktop and mobile and respects reduced-motion preferences. The backend must be running on the same origin; do not open `app.html` directly as a local file. Loading the interface does not create an interview. Starting a session or submitting an answer makes real AI calls when credentials are configured.

parts.text:
Implemented the frontend error-handling and draft-recovery improvements. **The agent logic and existing server-side interview data are preserved.**

### Changes
- API errors now retain strictly allowlisted diagnostic metadata and show clearer messages for quota limits, unavailable models, transport failures, and invalid AI output.
- A collapsed **Development technical details** section displays category, stage, and upstream HTTP status only when the backend supplies local/development-gated diagnostics. Raw error text and sensitive fields are discarded.
- Unsent answers are saved in tab-scoped `sessionStorage`, bound to the session, question sequence, and saved-answer count.
- Reload restores the same session and draft through a progress GET. Failed or pending submissions still require an explicit refresh before another POST.
- Confirmed saved answers clear their drafts; drafts for changed questions stay separate from the next answer. No automatic retries were added.

### Files changed
- **Added:** `public/assets/answer-draft.mjs`
- **Updated:** `public/assets/interview-api.mjs`, `public/assets/app.mjs`, `public/app.html`, `public/assets/app.css`
- **Tests:** `tests/FrontendTest.mjs`, `tests/FrontendHttpTest.php`, `tests/Support/IsolatedHttpServer.php`
- **Documentation:** `README.md`

### Verification
- **6 frontend tests passed**, covering diagnostics sanitization, failure messages, reload recovery, storage failure handling, and duplicate-submission guards.
- **All 7 PHP test suites passed.**
- JavaScript syntax checks and PHP syntax checks for the changed test files passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Draft persistence works in the same tab when browser storage is available; the UI reports when only in-memory retention is possible. This protects drafts entered with the updated frontend—it cannot recover an earlier draft that was already lost.

No live Gemini, OpenAI, or neatlogs requests were made. Private `.env` was untouched, and no commits or pushes were made.

+4. Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`. The health endpoint returns a JSON status and initializes the SQLite database at `data/jobready.sqlite` on first request. Use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/app.html` for the candidate interface.
+
 ## Candidate interface
 
 Open **`http://127.0.0.1:8000/app.html`** for the JobReady frontend. It is vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with no build step, external fonts, or frontend dependencies. The existing `/` health endpoint and interview APIs are preserved.
 
 The interface includes a preparation brief, adaptive interview workspace, backend-provided focus areas, saved-answer journal, claim evidence reviews when returned, and a completion/readiness report. It distinguishes `probe_answer` follow-ups from new questions. It does not invent evaluation scores, percentage progress, or a fixed question count. All candidate and AI text is rendered with text nodes rather than HTML.
 
 Use **Refresh progress** to load the current saved session, or paste an existing ID into **Already have an interview session?**. The session ID and latest unsent answer draft are remembered in tab-scoped `sessionStorage`; CVs, job descriptions, full answer history, and reports are not persisted in browser storage. Treat the ID as private because the backend currently uses it to access the session. Drafts are bound to the session ID, question decision sequence, and saved-answer count. They survive page reloads in the same tab when browser storage is available, and are cleared once the corresponding saved answer is confirmed or a new session is created. If storage is unavailable, the interface reports that the draft is retained only in memory.
 
 After an uncertain or failed submission, an explicit **Refresh progress** is required before another POST—even after a page reload. Reload restoration performs only a progress GET and never auto-submits a draft. A draft for a changed question is displayed separately for reference rather than inserted into the next answer. There are no automatic POST retries. Existing server sessions and saved answers are not reset by these frontend recovery controls.
 
 Error messages distinguish recognized provider failures such as quota limits, unavailable models, transport failures, and invalid AI output without echoing raw provider messages. A collapsed **Development technical details** section shows only allowlisted category, stage, and upstream HTTP status when the backend supplies development-gated diagnostics. The backend's existing local/development + `APP_DEBUG=true` gate remains authoritative; production responses without metadata do not reveal the section. Credentials, headers, candidate inputs, and raw response bodies are never included. Safe provider/cURL metadata is retained in the frontend error object, not persisted in draft storage.
 
 Controls support keyboard navigation, visible focus, labeled inputs, status announcements, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter for answer submission. The layout adapts to desktop and mobile and respects reduced-motion preferences. The backend must be running on the same origin; do not open `app.html` directly as a local file. Loading the interface does not create an interview. Starting a session or submitting an answer makes real AI calls when credentials are configured.
 
+### Upload a CV document
+
+Choose or drop one **PDF or modern Word DOCX**, up to **5 MB (5,242,880 bytes)**, in the preparation screen. Paste-text input remains available. Extracted text fills the CV field for review/editing; it is not sent to Gemini until you explicitly start the interview. Failed extraction leaves existing pasted CV text unchanged. Scanned/image-only PDFs require OCR elsewhere or pasted text; this MVP does not run OCR. If extracted text exceeds the existing 20,000-byte interview CV limit, shorten it in the field before starting.
+
+`POST /api/cv/extract` accepts `multipart/form-data` with one `cv_file` and returns `{"text":"...", "format":"pdf"}` (or `docx`). Errors return a fixed `error` message and an allowlisted `code`. Extension, actual bytes/MIME, PHP upload errors, and actual size are checked. This endpoint bypasses private environment loading, interview storage, AI clients, and neatlogs.
+
+PDFs use **smalot/pdfparser 2.12.5**, with its small Symfony mbstring polyfill dependency; versions are locked in `composer.lock`, and `/vendor/` remains Git-ignored. DOCX uses native PHP ZIP/DOM support. Extraction runs in a separate trusted PHP worker with a 96 MB memory limit, eight-second deadline, bounded output, external XML entity loading disabled, and URL/process-execution functions disabled. Uploaded data is parsed, never executed. PDF decompression and page counts are bounded; encrypted files are refused. DOCX packages are never unpacked to disk: unsafe paths, symlinks, encrypted entries, embedded objects/macros, excessive entry counts/sizes, high compression ratios, DTDs/entities, and malformed XML/packages are rejected. Readable output is capped at 64,000 bytes; overly complex documents receive a clear error.
+
+The PHP-owned temporary upload is removed on success or rejection; uploaded files are not permanently stored or written to SQLite. Keep the extraction worker and `vendor/` outside the public web root. No Poppler, Word, OCR service, frontend dependency, or build tool is required. Restart an existing development server using the upload-limit command above; PHP's default upload limit may be below 5 MB. If the dependency or worker is unavailable, paste-text preparation remains usable.
+
 Interview workflow data (including candidate-provided CV, job description, and answers) is stored in SQLite. AI credentials are read server-side and never sent to the browser. Model calls use bounded inputs, timeouts, and structured JSON validation. Candidate text is treated as untrusted content, and raw candidate data is not written to application logs or observability events.
 
 ### AI provider setup
 
 Configure these values privately in `.env` (preserve your existing private key):
 
 ```dotenv
 AI_PROVIDER=gemini
 REDACTED
 GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash-lite
 ```
 
 Gemini is the default when `AI_PROVIDER` is absent. The client uses Google's [official REST generateContent API](https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content), with the key in the `x-goog-api-key` header and JSON response mode. The selected model is Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, which has offered free-tier text usage, subject to your account's quota, region, and current [model availability](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models) and [pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing). Verify availability for your account before a live test; free-tier quota is not guaranteed. Set `GEMINI_MODEL` to another compatible JSON-capable Gemini text model if needed.
 
 Use `AI_PROVIDER=openai` with `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_MODEL` to select the existing OpenAI client. Unsupported provider names fail configuration. Existing process environment variables take precedence over `.env`, so restart the PHP server after changing configuration and check for stale exported settings.
 
 Gemini timeouts, quota/rate-limit errors, safety blocks, and malformed/truncated output fail safely. Failed interview turns roll back and leave the previous question available for retry; there are no automatic provider retries or fallbacks. The existing PHP action/tool validator still determines which decisions can execute. Merely loading bootstrap or the health endpoint makes no AI request; starting an interview or submitting an answer does.
 
 #### Safe development diagnostics
 
 To diagnose an explicitly approved local AI test, set these non-secret values in your private `.env` yourself and restart the PHP server:
 
 ```dotenv
 APP_ENV=local
 APP_DEBUG=true
 ```
 
 Diagnostics are exposed only when `APP_ENV` is exactly `local` or `development` **and** `APP_DEBUG=true`. Other environments, or debug disabled, retain the existing generic error response. Restore `APP_DEBUG=false` after local diagnosis. Existing exported process settings take precedence over `.env`.
 
 Failed AI requests can include an allowlisted `diagnostics` object containing `provider`, `category`, `stage` (`plan`, `decision`, or `claim_verification`), and, when known, `upstream_http_status`, numeric `curl_error_code`, `provider_code`, or a fixed `reason`. Categories distinguish configuration, authentication, authorization, invalid request, model availability, quota/rate limits, provider availability, transport, and invalid output. PHP plan/action/evaluation validation errors retain HTTP 502 while identifying invalid output. Diagnostic metadata never includes credentials, URLs, headers, free-form provider messages, raw response bodies, prompts, or candidate text; no raw error body is logged. HTTP-based categories indicate the failure class, not definitive proof of the responsible service (for example, an intermediary can also return HTTP 403).
 
 Temporary runtime probe: `GET /api/dev/status` is available only with the same exact local/development and debug gate; otherwise it returns HTTP 404. It reports exactly `APP_ENV`, `debug_enabled`, `AI_PROVIDER`, `GEMINI_MODEL`, `diagnostics_enabled`, and `sqlite_driver_available`. Provider/model values use the effective configuration and defaults; malformed model names are reported as `null` rather than echoed. It exposes no keys, database paths, environment-file contents, or candidate data, and makes no AI or neatlogs requests. Inspect `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/dev/status` before another approved live interview test.
 
 neatlogs uses the documented [`POST /v1/trace` HTTP ingest contract](https://docs.neatlogs.com/sdk/http-injection). Configure `NEATLOGS_WRITE_KEY` and `NEATLOGS_PROJECT` in `.env`; the key is read only by PHP and is never returned to the browser. When either value is absent, tracing is a no-op. Transport and HTTP failures are handled without interrupting JobReady, and error logs contain no token, payload, or response body.
 
 ## Interview API (JSON)
 
 - `POST /api/interviews` — start an individualized session. JSON body: `{"cv_text":"...", "job_description":"...", "target_role":"..."}`. Returns the session ID, generated plan, and first question.
 - `POST /api/interviews/{id}/answers` — submit a response. JSON body: `{"answer":"..."}`. The agent evaluates context and chooses its next action; it may ask a new question, probe the answer, verify a claim against supplied evidence, or finish.
 - `GET /api/interviews/{id}` — retrieve progress, questions, answers, decisions, evaluations, and any current question. CV and job-description fields are not returned.
 
 Requests must use `Content-Type: application/json`. CV text is limited to 20 KB, job descriptions to 16 KB, role names to 200 bytes, answers to 8 KB, and interviews to 20 submitted answers. Agent decisions are bounded to three per API turn.

 These use fake model/HTTP responses and SQLite in-memory databases. They do not load private `.env` or make Gemini, OpenAI, or neatlogs requests. The Gemini tests cover response parsing, request shape, invalid responses/actions, adaptive workflow compatibility, quota/timeouts, and transactional recovery.
 
 The frontend JavaScript tests use Node.js 20+ built-in testing tools (development only, no packages). They verify the PHP response contract, UTF-8 input limits, exact API paths, request timeouts, no automatic retries, allowlisted error diagnostics, production fallback messages, text-only rendering, follow-up display, tab-scoped draft persistence, page-reload recovery, submission guards, and completion reports with fake DOM/fetch fixtures. The frontend HTTP test checks HTML/assets/module MIME types on an isolated PHP server and verifies the health endpoint remains unchanged.
 
+Document tests generate fictional PDF/DOCX fixtures in temporary directories. They cover readable/Unicode text, scanned PDFs, encryption, format spoofing, malformed documents/XML, upload errors and size limits, archive traversal/symlinks/macros, compression bombs, entity rejection, real multipart extraction, and prompt temporary-file cleanup. +
 The diagnostics suite also uses credential-free isolated PHP servers to verify the actual API exposure gate. Its valid fictional requests fail on the fixture's missing key before any external request; it covers generic production responses and development-only metadata.
 
 Run the local HTTP health test with `php tests/HealthEndpointTest.php`. It starts an isolated PHP server on a temporary loopback port, asserts that `GET /` returns HTTP 200 and JSON containing `status: "ok"` and `service: "JobReady"`, and cleans up afterward. It uses a disposable application copy, credential-free environment fixture, and temporary SQLite database; it does not read your private `.env` or contact any external API. PHP `proc_open` and the existing cURL extension must be available.
 
 Run `php tests/InterviewConnectivityTest.php` to check the interview API route without AI calls. It posts an empty JSON object to `/api/interviews` and expects HTTP 422 with a structured missing-field error, then checks malformed JSON returns HTTP 400. Both HTTP tests share the same isolated-server helper and require no existing development server. A pass establishes local routing/validation connectivity in the fixture, not Gemini availability or the state of your separate running server. Failure output includes only a fixed diagnostic phase.

parts.text:
Enhance JobReady's candidate preparation screen with secure CV document upload support.
Support PDF (.pdf) and modern Word (.docx) files, while preserving the existing paste-text option.

Requirements:

1. Add an attractive upload area consistent with JobReady's existing premium interface.
2. Allow the candidate to select a PDF or DOCX file, maximum 5 MB.
3. Add a secure PHP endpoint that extracts readable text from uploaded files.
4. Validate extension, actual file format, size, and upload errors server-side.
5. Reject encrypted, malformed, unsupported, or oversized documents with clear errors.
6. Use a safe, lightweight extraction method appropriate for PHP 8.2. Do not execute uploaded content.
7. Do not allow ZIP bombs, unsafe file paths, or unrestricted XML parsing.
8. Do not permanently store uploaded files. Delete temporary files promptly.
9. Display the extracted text in the existing CV field so candidates can review and edit it before starting.
10. Preserve all existing interview endpoints and agent logic.
11. Handle scanned or image-only PDFs by explaining that readable text could not be extracted. OCR is not required for this MVP.
12. Add automated tests using safe PDF and DOCX fixtures.
13. Keep the interface responsive and accessible.
14. Do not send uploaded CVs to Gemini until the candidate explicitly starts an interview.
15. Do not read or modify private .env, make live provider requests, commit, or push.

Inspect the existing frontend and backend architecture first, implement the smallest reliable solution, and run the relevant tests.

Report changed files, test results, dependency requirements, and local preview instructions.

I’ll inspect the upload and extraction options first, then add a separate endpoint that fills the existing CV field for review. Uploading will not start an interview or call Gemini. For PDFs, I’ll use a maintained text extractor if one is available rather than build a fragile custom PDF parser.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

use JobReady\Http\HttpException;
use JobReady\Http\ErrorResponse;

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');

function jsonResponse(int $status, array $payload): never
{
    http_response_code($status);
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

try {
    $services = require dirname(__DIR__) . '/config/bootstrap.php';
    $method = strtoupper($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET');
    $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH) ?: '/';
    if ($method === 'POST' && str_starts_with($path, '/api/interviews')) {
        set_time_limit(65);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/') {
        jsonResponse(200, ['status' => 'ok', 'service' => 'JobReady']);
    }

    if ($path === '/api/dev/status') {
        $enabled = in_array($services['environment'], ['local', 'development'], true)
            && $services['debug'] === true;
        if ($method !== 'GET' || !$enabled) {
            throw new HttpException(404, 'Endpoint not found.');
        }
        // Explicit non-secret fields only; never serialize the environment or service container.
        $model = $services['gemini_model'];
        jsonResponse(200, [
            'APP_ENV' => $services['environment'],
            'debug_enabled' => $services['debug'],
            'AI_PROVIDER' => $services['ai_provider'],
            'GEMINI_MODEL' => preg_match('/^gemini-[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{1,100}$/D', $model) === 1 ? $model : null,
            'diagnostics_enabled' => $enabled,
            'sqlite_driver_available' => in_array('sqlite', PDO::getAvailableDrivers(), true),
        ]);
    }

    $contentType = strtolower(trim(explode(';', $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '')[0]));
    $body = null;
    if ($method === 'POST') {
        if ($contentType !== 'application/json') {
            throw new HttpException(415, 'Content-Type must be application/json.');
        }
        $contentLength = (int) ($_SERVER['CONTENT_LENGTH'] ?? 0);
        if ($contentLength > 50000) {
            throw new HttpException(413, 'Request body exceeds the size limit.');
        }
        $raw = file_get_contents('php://input', false, null, 0, 50001);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) > 50000) {
            throw new HttpException(413, 'Request body exceeds the size limit.');
        }
        try {
            $body = json_decode($raw, true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException) {
            throw new HttpException(400, 'Request body must be valid JSON.');
        }
        if (!is_array($body)) {
            throw new HttpException(400, 'Request body must be a JSON object.');
        }
    }

    if ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/api/interviews') {
        jsonResponse(201, $services['interview_service']->start($body));
    }

    if (preg_match('#^/api/interviews/([a-f0-9-]{36})/answers$#i', $path, $matches)) {
        if ($method !== 'POST') {
            throw new HttpException(405, 'Method not allowed.');
        }
        jsonResponse(200, $services['interview_service']->submitAnswer($matches[1], $body['answer'] ?? null));
    }

    if (preg_match('#^/api/interviews/([a-f0-9-]{36})$#i', $path, $matches)) {
        if ($method !== 'GET') {
            throw new HttpException(405, 'Method not allowed.');
        }
        jsonResponse(200, $services['interview_service']->getProgress($matches[1]));
    }

    throw new HttpException(404, 'Endpoint not found.');
} catch (HttpException $exception) {
    jsonResponse($exception->status, ErrorResponse::fromException(
        $exception,
        $services['environment'] ?? 'production',
        ($services['debug'] ?? false) === true,
    ));
} catch (Throwable $exception) {
    error_log('JobReady request failed: ' . get_class($exception));
    jsonResponse(500, ['error' => 'An internal error occurred.']);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/** Test-only server using disposable PHP files, SQLite, and no private environment. */
final class IsolatedHttpServer
{
    // Valid fictional input is permitted only to test missing-key diagnostics in this keyless fixture.
    public const DIAGNOSTIC_REQUEST = '{"cv_text":"Fictional developer built a PHP inventory application.","job_description":"Junior PHP role working on APIs, debugging, and security.","target_role":"Junior PHP Developer"}';
    private string $fixture;
    private string $address;
    private $process = null;

    public function __construct(string $environmentName = 'local', bool $debug = false)
    {
        $this->fixture = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/jobready-http-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        try {
            self::ensure(function_exists('proc_open') && function_exists('curl_init'), 'server_prerequisites');
            self::ensure(in_array($environmentName, ['local', 'development', 'production', 'staging'], true), 'fixture_environment_name');
            self::ensure(mkdir($this->fixture, 0700), 'fixture_creation');
            foreach (['public', 'config', 'src'] as $directory) {
                self::copyFixture(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/' . $directory, $this->fixture . '/' . $directory);
            }
            self::ensure(file_put_contents($this->fixture . '/.env', 'APP_ENV=' . $environmentName . "\nAPP_DEBUG=" . ($debug ? 'true' : 'false') . "\nAPP_DB_PATH=data/test.sqlite\nAI_PROVIDER=gemini\nGEMINI_API_KEY=\nOPENAI_API_KEY=\nNEATLOGS_WRITE_KEY=\nNEATLOGS_PROJECT=\n") !== false, 'fixture_environment');

            $reservation = @stream_socket_server('tcp://127.0.0.1:0', $error, $message);
            self::ensure($reservation !== false, 'port_reservation');
            $address = stream_socket_get_name($reservation, false);
            fclose($reservation);
            self::ensure(is_string($address), 'port_detection');
            $this->address = $address;

            // No inherited provider keys, proxy variables, or application configuration.
            $environment = [];
            foreach (['PATH', 'SystemRoot', 'WINDIR', 'TEMP', 'TMP', 'TMPDIR'] as $name) {
                $value = getenv($name);
                if ($value !== false) {
                    $environment[$name] = $value;
                }
            }
            $null = PHP_OS_FAMILY === 'Windows' ? 'NUL' : '/dev/null';
            $this->process = proc_open(
                [PHP_BINARY, '-d', 'display_errors=0', '-S', $address, '-t', $this->fixture . '/public'],
                [0 => ['file', $null, 'r'], 1 => ['file', $null, 'a'], 2 => ['file', $null, 'a']],
                $pipes,
                $this->fixture,
                $environment,
                ['bypass_shell' => true],
            );

            $ready = false;
            $deadline = microtime(true) + 5;
            while (microtime(true) < $deadline && proc_get_status($this->process)['running']) {
                $socket = @stream_socket_client('tcp://' . $address, $error, $message, 0.1);

        }

    public function request(string $method, string $path, ?string $body = null): array
    {

        }

            '/', '/api/dev/status', '/app.html', '/assets/app.css', '/assets/app.mjs',
            '/assets/interview-api.mjs', '/assets/answer-draft.mjs', '/assets/jobready.svg',
        ], true) && $body === null)
            || ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/api/interviews' && in_array($body, ['{}', '{', self::DIAGNOSTIC_REQUEST], true)), 'request_allowlist');

        self::ensure($curl !== false, 'http_initialization');
        try {
            $options = [
                CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => $method,
                CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
                CURLOPT_PROXY => '',
                CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
                CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 2,
                CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 5,
            ];
            if ($body !== null) {
                $options[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = $body;
                $options[CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER] = ['Content-Type: application/json'];
            }

    }

    public function stop(): void
    {
        if (is_resource($this->process)) {

    private static function ensure(bool $condition, string $category): void

        }
    }

    private static function copyFixture(string $source, string $destination): void

            if ($entry->isDot() || $entry->isLink()) {
                continue;
            }
            $target = $destination . '/' . $entry->getFilename();
            if ($entry->isDir()) {
                self::copyFixture($entry->getPathname(), $target);
            } elseif (in_array($entry->getExtension(), ['php', 'html', 'css', 'mjs', 'svg'], true)) {
                self::ensure(copy($entry->getPathname(), $target), 'fixture_copy');
            }
        }
    }

    private static function removeFixture(string $directory): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($directory)) {
            return;
        }
        foreach (new DirectoryIterator($directory) as $entry) {
            if ($entry->isDot()) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($entry->isDir() && !$entry->isLink()) {
                self::removeFixture($entry->getPathname());
            } else {
                unlink($entry->getPathname());
            }
        }
        rmdir($directory);
    }
}
