<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

use JobReady\Config\Environment;
use JobReady\AI\OpenAIClient;
use JobReady\AI\GeminiClient;
use JobReady\Interview\DecisionValidator;
use JobReady\Interview\InterviewService;
use JobReady\Observability\NeatlogsClientInterface;
use JobReady\Observability\NeatlogsClient;
use JobReady\Observability\NullNeatlogsClient;
use JobReady\Storage\Database;
use JobReady\Storage\InterviewStore;
use JobReady\Storage\SessionStore;

define('JOBREADY_ROOT', dirname(__DIR__));

spl_autoload_register(static function (string $class): void {
    $prefix = 'JobReady\\';
    if (!str_starts_with($class, $prefix)) {
        return;
    }
    $relative = substr($class, strlen($prefix));
    $file = JOBREADY_ROOT . '/src/' . str_replace('\\', '/', $relative) . '.php';
    if (is_file($file)) {
        require $file;
    }
});

Environment::load(JOBREADY_ROOT . '/.env');
$databasePath = Environment::get('APP_DB_PATH', 'data/jobready.sqlite');
if ($databasePath === null || $databasePath === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('APP_DB_PATH must be configured.');
}
if (!str_starts_with($databasePath, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) && !preg_match('/^[A-Za-z]:[\\\\\/]/', $databasePath)) {
    $databasePath = JOBREADY_ROOT . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $databasePath;
}

$pdo = Database::connect($databasePath);
$sessionStore = new SessionStore($pdo);
$interviewStore = new InterviewStore($pdo);
$writeKey = Environment::get('NEATLOGS_WRITE_KEY');
$project = Environment::get('NEATLOGS_PROJECT');
$neatlogsClient = ($writeKey !== null && trim($writeKey) !== '' && $project !== null && trim($project) !== '')
    ? new NeatlogsClient($writeKey, $project)
    : new NullNeatlogsClient();
assert($neatlogsClient instanceof NeatlogsClientInterface);
$provider = strtolower(trim(Environment::get('AI_PROVIDER', 'gemini') ?? 'gemini'));
$geminiModel = Environment::get('GEMINI_MODEL', GeminiClient::DEFAULT_MODEL) ?? GeminiClient::DEFAULT_MODEL;
$openAI = match ($provider) {
    'gemini' => new GeminiClient(
        Environment::get('GEMINI_API_KEY'),
        $geminiModel,
    ),
    'openai' => new OpenAIClient(
        Environment::get('OPENAI_API_KEY'),
        Environment::get('OPENAI_MODEL', 'gpt-4o-mini') ?? 'gpt-4o-mini',
    ),
    default => throw new RuntimeException('Unsupported AI provider configuration.'),
};
$interviewService = new InterviewService($pdo, $interviewStore, $openAI, new DecisionValidator(), $neatlogsClient);

return [
    'environment' => Environment::get('APP_ENV', 'production'),
    'debug' => Environment::get('APP_DEBUG', 'false') === 'true',
    'ai_provider' => $provider,
    'gemini_model' => $geminiModel,
    'pdo' => $pdo,
    'session_store' => $sessionStore,
    'interview_store' => $interviewStore,
    'interview_service' => $interviewService,
    'neatlogs' => $neatlogsClient,
];

namespace Smalot\PdfParser;

use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementArray;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementBoolean;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementDate;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementHexa;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementName;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementNull;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementNumeric;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementString;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Element\ElementXRef;
use Smalot\PdfParser\RawData\RawDataParser;

/**
 * Class Parser
 */
class Parser
{
    /**
     * @var Config
     */
    private $config;

    /**
     * @var PDFObject[]
     */
    protected $objects = [];

    protected $rawDataParser;

    public function __construct($cfg = [], ?Config $config = null)
    {
        $this->config = $config ?: new Config();
        $this->rawDataParser = new RawDataParser($cfg, $this->config);
    }

    public function getConfig(): Config
    {
        return $this->config;
    }

    /**
     * @throws \Exception
     */
    public function parseFile(string $filename): Document
    {
        // parseContent() holds the only reference to the file content, which
        // enables it to release the content.
        return $this->parseContent(file_get_contents($filename));
    }

    /**
     * @param string $content PDF content to parse
     *
     * @throws \Exception if secured PDF file was detected
     * @throws \Exception if no object list was found
     */
    public function parseContent(string $content): Document
    {
        // Normalize the raw data and decode the cross-reference/trailer table.
        list($xref, $pdfData) = $this->rawDataParser->parseHeaderAndXref($content);

        // $pdfData is a copy of $content, if $content had to be normalized (bytes
        // in front of the header, line endings). $content is released to avoid
        // holding both while the objects are parsed.
        unset($content);

        if (isset($xref['trailer']['encrypt']) && false === $this->config->getIgnoreEncryption()) {
            throw new \Exception('Secured pdf file are currently not supported.');
        }

        // Create destination object.
        $document = new Document();
        $this->objects = [];

        // The raw objects are decoded one at a time. Each raw structure is
        // turned into a PDFObject and goes out of scope before the next one
        // gets decoded, so only one raw structure is held in memory at a time.
        foreach ($this->rawDataParser->iterateIndirectObjects($pdfData, $xref) as $id => $structure) {
            $this->parseObject($id, $structure, $document);
        }

        if (empty($this->objects)) {
            throw new \Exception('Object list not found. Possible secured file.');
        }

        $document->setTrailer($this->parseTrailer($xref['trailer'], $document));
        $document->setObjects($this->objects);

        return $document;
    }

    protected function parseTrailer(array $structure, ?Document $document)
    {
        $trailer = [];

        foreach ($structure as $name => $values) {
            $name = ucfirst($name);

            if (is_numeric($values)) {
                $trailer[$name] = new ElementNumeric($values);
            } elseif (\is_array($values)) {
                $value = $this->parseTrailer($values, null);
                $trailer[$name] = new ElementArray($value, null);
            } elseif (false !== strpos($values, '_')) {
                $trailer[$name] = new ElementXRef($values, $document);
            } else {
                $trailer[$name] = $this->parseHeaderElement('(', $values, $document);
            }
        }

        return new Header($trailer, $document);
    }

    protected function parseObject(string $id, array $structure, ?Document $document)
    {
        $header = new Header([], $document);
        $content = '';

        foreach ($structure as $position => $part) {
            if (\is_int($part)) {
                $part = [null, null];
            }
            switch ($part[0]) {
                case '[':
                    $elements = [];

                    foreach ($part[1] as $sub_element) {
                        $sub_type = $sub_element[0];
                        $sub_value = $sub_element[1];
                        $elements[] = $this->parseHeaderElement($sub_type, $sub_value, $document);
                    }

                    $header = new Header($elements, $document);
                    break;

                case '<<':
                    $header = $this->parseHeader($part[1], $document);
                    break;

                case 'stream':
                    $content = isset($part[3][0]) ? $part[3][0] : $part[1];

                    if ($header->get('Type')->equals('ObjStm')) {
                        list($objectNumbers, $byteOffsets, $firstObjectOffset) = $this->getObjectStreamIndex($header, $content);
                        $content = substr($content, $firstObjectOffset);
                        $table = [];

                        foreach ($byteOffsets as $key => $byteOffset) {
                            // A byte offset with as many digits as PHP_INT_MAX or more
                            // is located behind the content in any case
                            $position = \strlen($byteOffset) < \strlen((string) \PHP_INT_MAX) ? (int) $byteOffset : \PHP_INT_MAX;
                            $table[$position] = $objectNumbers[$key];
                        }

                        ksort($table);

                        $ids = array_values($table);
                        $positions = array_keys($table);

                        foreach ($positions as $index => $position) {
                            $id = $ids[$index].'_0';
                            $next_position = isset($positions[$index + 1]) ? $positions[$index + 1] : \strlen($content);
                            $sub_content = substr($content, $position, (int) $next_position - (int) $position);

                            $sub_header = Header::parse($sub_content, $document);
                            $object = PDFObject::factory($document, $sub_header, '', $this->config);
                            $this->objects[$id] = $object;
                        }

                        // It is not necessary to store this content.

                        return;
                    } elseif ($header->get('Type')->equals('Metadata')) {
                        // Attempt to parse XMP XML Metadata
                        $document->extractXMPMetadata($content);
                    }
                    break;

                default:
                    if ('null' != $part) {
                        $element = $this->parseHeaderElement($part[0], $part[1], $document);

                        if ($element) {
                            $header = new Header([$element], $document);
                        }
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        if (!isset($this->objects[$id])) {
            $this->objects[$id] = PDFObject::factory($document, $header, $content, $this->config);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Provides the index of an object stream and the byte offset of its first
     * object.
     *
     * The index consists of pairs of integers: the number of an object and its
     * byte offset relative to the first object. The index is expected to end
     * with the last pair, which directly follows another pair.
     *
     * Integer objects behind the index look like pairs. /First, the byte offset
     * of the first object, tells them apart. It is used, if it is located
     * between two pairs and the number of pairs in front of it equals /N (as
     * far as /N is usable).
     *
     * @return array{0: array<int, string>, 1: array<int, string>, 2: int} [$objectNumbers, $byteOffsets, $firstObjectOffset]
     *
     * @see https://opensource.adobe.com/dc-acrobat-sdk-docs/pdfstandards/PDF32000_2008.pdf#page=53 ISO 32000-1:2008, 7.5.7 (object streams)
     * @see https://opensource.adobe.com/dc-acrobat-sdk-docs/pdfstandards/PDF32000_2008.pdf#page=54 ISO 32000-1:2008, 7.5.7, Table 16 (N, First)
     */
    private function getObjectStreamIndex(Header $header, string $content): array
    {
        // \G lets a pair start where the previous one ends. White-space is \s
        // and the null character.
        $pattern = '/\G[\s\0]*(\d+)[\s\0]+(\d+)[\s\0]*/';
        preg_match_all($pattern, $content, $index);
        $length = \strlen(implode('', $index[0]));

        $first = $this->getObjectStreamInteger($header, 'First', $length - 1);

        if (
            null === $first
            // only white-space between /First and the end of the pairs
            || false === strpbrk(substr($content, $first, $length - $first), '0123456789')
            // /First is located inside of a number
            || (0 < $first && 2 === strspn($content, '0123456789', $first - 1, 2))
        ) {
            return [$index[1], $index[2], $length];
        }

        preg_match_all($pattern, substr($content, 0, $first), $indexInFrontOfFirst);
        $numberOfObjects = $this->getObjectStreamInteger($header, 'N', \strlen($content));

        if (
            $first !== \strlen(implode('', $indexInFrontOfFirst[0]))
            || (null !== $numberOfObjects && \count($indexInFrontOfFirst[0]) !== $numberOfObjects)
        ) {
            return [$index[1], $index[2], $length];
        }

        return [$indexInFrontOfFirst[1], $indexInFrontOfFirst[2], $first];
    }

    /**
     * Provides an integer entry of the dictionary of an object stream. Null is
     * returned, if the entry is missing, an indirect reference or outside of
     * the range from 0 to $max.
     *
     * @see https://opensource.adobe.com/dc-acrobat-sdk-docs/pdfstandards/PDF32000_2008.pdf#page=54 ISO 32000-1:2008, 7.5.7, Table 16 (N, First)
     */
    private function getObjectStreamInteger(Header $header, string $name, int $max): ?int
    {
        $element = $header->get($name);

        if (!$element instanceof ElementNumeric) {
            return null;
        }

        $value = $element->getContent();

        return 0 <= $value && $value <= $max ? (int) $value : null;
    }

    /**
     * @throws \Exception
     */
    protected function parseHeader(array $structure, ?Document $document): Header
    {
        $elements = [];
        $count = \count($structure);

        for ($position = 0; $position < $count; $position += 2) {
            $name = $structure[$position][1];
            $type = $structure[$position + 1][0];
            $value = $structure[$position + 1][1];

            $elements[$name] = $this->parseHeaderElement($type, $value, $document);
        }

        return new Header($elements, $document);
    }

    /**
     * @param string|array $value
     *
     * @return Element|Header|null
     *
     * @throws \Exception
     */
    protected function parseHeaderElement(?string $type, $value, ?Document $document)
    {
        $valueIsEmpty = null == $value || '' == $value || false == $value;
        if (('<<' === $type || '>>' === $type) && $valueIsEmpty) {
            $value = [];
        }

        switch ($type) {
            case '<<':
            case '>>':
                $header = $this->parseHeader($value, $document);
                PDFObject::factory($document, $header, null, $this->config);

                return $header;

            case 'numeric':
                return new ElementNumeric($value);

            case 'boolean':
                return new ElementBoolean($value);

            case 'null':
                return new ElementNull();

            case '(':
                if ($date = ElementDate::parse('('.$value.')', $document)) {
                    return $date;
                }

                return ElementString::parse('('.$value.')', $document);

            case '<':
                return $this->parseHeaderElement('(', ElementHexa::decode($value), $document);

            case '/':
                return ElementName::parse('/'.$value, $document);

            case 'ojbref': // old mistake in tcpdf parser
            case 'objref':
                return new ElementXRef($value, $document);

            case '[':
                $values = [];

                if (\is_array($value)) {
                    foreach ($value as $sub_element) {
                        $sub_type = $sub_element[0];
                        $sub_value = $sub_element[1];
                        $values[] = $this->parseHeaderElement($sub_type, $sub_value, $document);

parts.text:
Implemented secure **PDF and DOCX CV uploads**, while preserving paste-text preparation and all existing interview endpoints.

### What’s available
- Accessible, responsive upload/drop area with a **5 MB limit**.
- New **`POST /api/cv/extract`** endpoint accepting one multipart field named `cv_file`.
- Extracted text fills the CV field for review and editing. Uploading does **not** start an interview or send content to Gemini.
- Clear errors for encrypted, malformed, unsupported, oversized, and image-only documents. Failed extraction preserves existing pasted text.
- Server-side checks for actual format, upload errors, archive paths, encryption, compression limits, and XML safety.
- Extraction runs in a bounded worker; temporary uploads are removed after success or rejection.

### Files changed
**Added**
- `composer.json`, `composer.lock`
- `config/autoload.php`
- `src/Documents/{CvUpload,DocumentException,DocumentExtractor,ExtractionProcess}.php`
- `scripts/extract-document.php`
- `public/assets/cv-upload.mjs`
- `tests/DocumentExtractionTest.php`
- `tests/CvUploadHttpTest.php`
- `tests/CvUploadFrontendTest.mjs`
- `tests/Support/DocumentFixtures.php`

**Updated**
- `config/bootstrap.php`, `public/index.php`
- `public/app.html`, `public/assets/app.css`, `public/assets/app.mjs`
- Existing frontend/HTTP test files and isolated-server helper
- `README.md`

### Verification
- **9 PHP test suites passed.**
- **9 JavaScript tests passed.**
- PHP syntax checks passed for all **36 project PHP files**; JavaScript syntax checks passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Composer validation succeeded with a missing-license-metadata warning; dependency audit found **no known security advisories**.

Tests covered real multipart uploads, temporary-file cleanup, encryption, scanned PDFs, malformed documents, ZIP traversal/symlinks/compression bombs, XML entities, and preservation of pasted text.

### Dependencies and preview
Installed the locked PDF parser **`smalot/pdfparser 2.12.5`** and its mbstring polyfill dependency. Extraction requires PHP CLI, `proc_open`, and the documented PHP extensions; no Poppler or Word installation is required.

Restart the development server with sufficient upload limits:

```powershell
php -d upload_max_filesize=5M -d post_max_size=6M -d display_errors=0 -S 127.0.0.1:8000 -t public
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:8000/app.html**. Select a document, review/edit its extracted text, then explicitly start the interview.

Private `.env` was not read or modified. No live provider requests, commits, or pushes were made.

- A real CV has been uploaded locally, so protecting personal information is especially important.
- The latest code changes have not yet been committed or pushed.

1. Inspect Git status and identify all modified, untracked, and ignored files.
2. Verify that .env, API credentials, uploaded CV files, temporary documents, SQLite databases, interview records, local logs, node_modules, vendor, and Entire/OpenCode runtime data are excluded from Git.
3. Check all proposed commit files for embedded credentials, personal information, sensitive test data, and unsafe local configuration.
4. Verify that composer.json and composer.lock are safe to commit, while vendor/ remains ignored.
5. Review the PDF/DOCX upload security controls and confirm temporary file cleanup.
6. Run all existing offline PHP and JavaScript tests, relevant syntax checks, and git diff --check.
7. Identify exactly which source files, tests, documentation, and dependency manifests should be committed.
8. Report any risks or required fixes before committing.

Important:
- Do not display or repeat secrets or personal CV content.
- Do not read my private .env file or real uploaded CV contents.
- Do not make live Gemini, OpenAI, or neatlogs requests.
- Do not modify files, stage changes, commit, or push.
- Report findings and stop for approval.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace JobReady\Documents;

final class CvUpload
{
    /** @return array{text: string, format: string} */
    public function extract(array $files, int $contentLength): array
    {
        try {
            if ($contentLength > DocumentExtractor::MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES + 128 * 1024) {
                throw new DocumentException('too_large');
            }
            $file = $files['cv_file'] ?? null;
            if (count($files) !== 1 || !is_array($file) || !isset($file['error']) || !is_int($file['error'])) {
                throw new DocumentException('upload_missing');
            }
            if (in_array($file['error'], [UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE, UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE], true)) {
                throw new DocumentException('too_large');
            }
            if ($file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) {
                throw new DocumentException('upload_missing');
            }
            if ($file['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                throw new DocumentException('upload_failed');
            }
            if (!isset($file['tmp_name'], $file['name'], $file['size']) || !is_string($file['tmp_name'])
                || !is_string($file['name']) || !is_int($file['size']) || !is_uploaded_file($file['tmp_name'])) {
                throw new DocumentException('upload_failed');
            }
            if ($file['size'] > DocumentExtractor::MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES || filesize($file['tmp_name']) !== $file['size']) {
                throw new DocumentException('too_large');
            }
            if (strlen($file['name']) > 255 || preg_match('/[\x00-\x1F\/\\\\]/', $file['name'])) {
                throw new DocumentException('unsupported');
            }
            $format = strtolower(pathinfo($file['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
            if (!in_array($format, ['pdf', 'docx'], true)) {
                throw new DocumentException('unsupported');
            }
            // Client MIME type is deliberately ignored; sniff bytes and inspect the actual format.
            DocumentExtractor::validateFormat($file['tmp_name'], $format);
            $text = (new ExtractionProcess())->extract($file['tmp_name'], $format);
            return ['text' => $text, 'format' => $format];
        } finally {
            // Delete only PHP-owned uploaded paths, including rejected/multiple-file uploads.
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                if (!is_array($file) || !isset($file['tmp_name'])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $paths = is_array($file['tmp_name'])
                    ? new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveArrayIterator($file['tmp_name']))
                    : [$file['tmp_name']];
                foreach ($paths as $path) {
                    if (is_string($path) && is_uploaded_file($path)) {
                        @unlink($path);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace JobReady\Documents;

final class ExtractionProcess
{
    public function extract(string $path, string $format): string
    {
        if (!function_exists('proc_open')) {
            throw new DocumentException('unavailable');
        }
        $binary = in_array(PHP_SAPI, ['cli', 'cli-server'], true) ? PHP_BINARY
            : PHP_BINDIR . '/php' . (PHP_OS_FAMILY === 'Windows' ? '.exe' : '');
        if (!is_executable($binary)) {
            throw new DocumentException('unavailable');
        }
        $environment = [];
        foreach (['PATH', 'SystemRoot', 'WINDIR', 'TEMP', 'TMP', 'TMPDIR'] as $name) {
            $value = getenv($name);
            if ($value !== false) {
                $environment[$name] = $value;
            }
        }
        $null = PHP_OS_FAMILY === 'Windows' ? 'NUL' : '/dev/null';
        $process = @proc_open([
            $binary, '-d', 'memory_limit=96M', '-d', 'max_execution_time=8',
            '-d', 'display_errors=0', '-d', 'log_errors=0', '-d', 'error_reporting=0',
            '-d', 'allow_url_fopen=0', '-d', 'allow_url_include=0',
            '-d', 'auto_prepend_file=', '-d', 'auto_append_file=',
            '-d', 'disable_functions=exec,shell_exec,system,passthru,proc_open,popen,pcntl_exec,dl,curl_exec,curl_multi_exec',
            dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/scripts/extract-document.php', $path, $format,
        ], [0 => ['file', $null, 'r'], 1 => ['pipe', 'w'], 2 => ['file', $null, 'a']], $pipes,
            dirname(__DIR__, 2), $environment, ['bypass_shell' => true]);
        if (!is_resource($process)) {
            throw new DocumentException('unavailable');
        }
        $output = '';
        $exitCode = -1;
        try {
            stream_set_blocking($pipes[1], false);
            $deadline = microtime(true) + 8;
            while (true) {
                $output .= stream_get_contents($pipes[1]);
                if (strlen($output) > 512 * 1024 || microtime(true) > $deadline) {
                    throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
                }
                $status = proc_get_status($process);
                if (!$status['running']) {
                    $exitCode = $status['exitcode'];
                    $output .= stream_get_contents($pipes[1]);
                    break;
                }
                usleep(10000);
            }
        } finally {
            if (proc_get_status($process)['running']) {
                proc_terminate($process);
            }
            fclose($pipes[1]);
            proc_close($process);
        }
        if ($exitCode !== 0 || strlen($output) > 512 * 1024) {
            throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
        }
        $result = json_decode($output, true, 8);
        if (!is_array($result)) {
            throw new DocumentException('malformed');
        }
        if (isset($result['error']) && is_string($result['error'])) {
            throw new DocumentException($result['error']);
        }
        if (!isset($result['text']) || !is_string($result['text']) || strlen($result['text']) > DocumentExtractor::MAX_TEXT_BYTES) {
            throw new DocumentException('malformed');
        }
        return $result['text'];
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace JobReady\Documents;

use DOMDocument;
use DOMXPath;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Config;
use Smalot\PdfParser\Parser;
use Throwable;
use ZipArchive;

/** Invoked only inside the memory/time-limited extraction worker. */
final class DocumentExtractor
{
    public const MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
    public const MAX_TEXT_BYTES = 64000;
    private const WORD_NAMESPACES = [
        'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main',
        'http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/wordprocessingml/main',
    ];

    public static function validateFormat(string $path, string $format): void
    {
        $size = filesize($path);
        if ($size === false || $size === 0) {
            throw new DocumentException('malformed');
        }
        if ($size > self::MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) {
            throw new DocumentException('too_large');
        }
        $header = file_get_contents($path, false, null, 0, 16);
        $mime = (new \finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE))->file($path);
        if ($format === 'pdf') {
            if (!is_string($header) || !preg_match('/^%PDF-(?:1\.[0-7]|2\.0)/', $header) || $mime !== 'application/pdf') {
                throw new DocumentException('malformed');
            }
        } elseif ($format === 'docx') {
            if (is_string($header) && str_starts_with($header, "\xD0\xCF\x11\xE0\xA1\xB1\x1A\xE1")) {
                throw new DocumentException('encrypted');
            }
            if (!is_string($header) || !str_starts_with($header, "PK\x03\x04")
                || !in_array($mime, ['application/zip', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'], true)) {
                throw new DocumentException('malformed');
            }
        } else {
            throw new DocumentException('unsupported');
        }
    }

    public function extract(string $path, string $format): string
    {
        self::validateFormat($path, $format);
        $text = $format === 'pdf' ? $this->pdf($path) : $this->docx($path);
        if (preg_match('//u', $text) !== 1) {
            throw new DocumentException('malformed');
        }
        $text = str_replace(["\r\n", "\r", "\f"], "\n", $text);
        $text = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/u', '', $text);
        $text = trim(preg_replace('/\n{3,}/', "\n\n", $text));
        if (strlen($text) > self::MAX_TEXT_BYTES) {
            throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
        }
        if ($text === '' || preg_match('/[\p{L}\p{N}]/u', $text) !== 1) {
            throw new DocumentException('no_text');
        }
        return $text;
    }

    private function pdf(string $path): string
    {
        if (!class_exists(Parser::class)) {
            throw new DocumentException('unavailable');
        }
        $config = new Config();
        $config->setRetainImageContent(false);
        $config->setDecodeMemoryLimit(4 * 1024 * 1024);
        $config->setIgnoreEncryption(false);
        try {
            $document = (new Parser([], $config))->parseFile($path);
            $pages = $document->getPages();
            if (count($pages) > 50) {
                throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
            }
            $text = '';
            foreach ($pages as $page) {
                $text .= $page->getText() . "\n";
                if (strlen($text) > self::MAX_TEXT_BYTES) {
                    throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
                }
            }
            return $text;
        } catch (DocumentException $exception) {
            throw $exception;
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            // Library text can contain document contents; use it only for internal classification.
            $encrypted = str_contains(strtolower($exception->getMessage()), 'secured')
                || str_contains(strtolower($exception->getMessage()), 'encrypt');
            throw new DocumentException($encrypted ? 'encrypted' : 'malformed');
        }
    }

    private function docx(string $path): string
    {
        if (!class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            throw new DocumentException('unavailable');
        }
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($path, ZipArchive::RDONLY | ZipArchive::CHECKCONS) !== true) {
            throw new DocumentException('malformed');
        }
        try {
            if ($zip->numFiles > 500) {
                throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
            }
            $names = [];
            $totalSize = 0;
            for ($index = 0; $index < $zip->numFiles; $index++) {
                $stat = $zip->statIndex($index);
                if ($stat === false) {
                    throw new DocumentException('malformed');
                }
                $name = $stat['name'];
                if (isset($names[$name]) || str_contains($name, "\0") || str_contains($name, '\\')
                    || str_starts_with($name, '/') || str_contains($name, ':')
                    || preg_match('#(?:^|/)\.{1,2}(?:/|$)#', $name)) {
                    throw new DocumentException('unsafe_archive');
                }
                $names[$name] = true;
                if ($zip->getExternalAttributesIndex($index, $system, $attributes)
                    && (($attributes >> 16) & 0xF000) === 0xA000) {
                    throw new DocumentException('unsafe_archive');
                }
                if (($stat['encryption_method'] ?? 0) !== ZipArchive::EM_NONE) {
                    throw new DocumentException('encrypted');
                }
                if (!in_array($stat['comp_method'], [ZipArchive::CM_STORE, ZipArchive::CM_DEFLATE], true)) {
                    throw new DocumentException('unsafe_archive');
                }
                $totalSize += $stat['size'];
                if ($totalSize > 20 * 1024 * 1024 || $stat['size'] > 8 * 1024 * 1024
                    || ($stat['size'] > 65536 && $stat['size'] > 100 * max(1, $stat['comp_size']))) {
                    throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
                }
                if (str_ends_with(strtolower($name), 'vbaproject.bin') || str_starts_with($name, 'word/embeddings/')) {
                    throw new DocumentException('unsafe_archive');
                }
            }
            foreach (['[Content_Types].xml', '_rels/.rels', 'word/document.xml'] as $required) {
                if (!isset($names[$required])) {
                    throw new DocumentException('malformed');
                }
            }
            $types = $this->xml($this->readEntry($zip, '[Content_Types].xml', 65536));
            $xpath = new DOMXPath($types);
            $xpath->registerNamespace('ct', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types');
            if ($xpath->query('/ct:Types/ct:Override[@PartName="/word/document.xml" and @ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"]')->length !== 1) {
                throw new DocumentException('malformed');
            }
            $relations = $this->xml($this->readEntry($zip, '_rels/.rels', 65536));
            $xpath = new DOMXPath($relations);
            $xpath->registerNamespace('r', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships');
            $main = $xpath->query('/r:Relationships/r:Relationship[@Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" or @Type="http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/officeDocument"]');
            if ($main->length !== 1 || $main->item(0)->getAttribute('TargetMode') === 'External'
                || !in_array($main->item(0)->getAttribute('Target'), ['word/document.xml', '/word/document.xml'], true)) {
                throw new DocumentException('malformed');
            }
            $document = $this->xml($this->readEntry($zip, 'word/document.xml', 2 * 1024 * 1024));
            if ($document->documentElement?->localName !== 'document'
                || !in_array($document->documentElement->namespaceURI, self::WORD_NAMESPACES, true)) {
                throw new DocumentException('malformed');
            }
            $xpath = new DOMXPath($document);
            $xpath->registerNamespace('w', $document->documentElement->namespaceURI);
            $body = $xpath->query('/w:document/w:body')->item(0);
            if ($body === null) {
                throw new DocumentException('malformed');
            }
            $text = '';
            $walk = function (\DOMNode $node, int $depth = 0) use (&$walk, &$text): void {
                if ($depth > 100) {
                    throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
                }
                if (in_array($node->namespaceURI, self::WORD_NAMESPACES, true)) {
                    if ($node->localName === 't') {
                        $text .= $node->textContent;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (in_array($node->localName, ['br', 'cr', 'tab'], true)) {
                        $text .= $node->localName === 'tab' ? "\t" : "\n";
                    }
                }
                foreach ($node->childNodes as $child) {
                    $walk($child, $depth + 1);
                }
                if ($node->localName === 'p' && in_array($node->namespaceURI, self::WORD_NAMESPACES, true)) {
                    $text .= "\n";
                }
                if (strlen($text) > self::MAX_TEXT_BYTES) {
                    throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
                }
            };
            $walk($body);
            return $text;
        } finally {
            $zip->close();
        }
    }

    private function readEntry(ZipArchive $zip, string $name, int $limit): string
    {
        $stat = $zip->statName($name);
        if ($stat === false || $stat['size'] > $limit) {
            throw new DocumentException('too_complex');
        }
        // Bounded decompression; no archive paths are ever extracted to the filesystem.
        $data = $zip->getFromName($name, $limit + 1);
        if (!is_string($data) || strlen($data) !== $stat['size'] || strlen($data) > $limit) {
            throw new DocumentException('malformed');
        }
        return $data;
    }

    private function xml(string $content): DOMDocument
    {
        // No DTD/entity expansion, network access, huge-parser flags, or recovery mode.
        if (preg_match('/<!\s*(?:DOCTYPE|ENTITY)\b/i', $content)) {
            throw new DocumentException('unsafe_archive');
        }
        $document = new DOMDocument();
        $document->resolveExternals = false;
        $document->substituteEntities = false;
        if (!$document->loadXML($content, LIBXML_NONET) || $document->doctype !== null) {
            throw new DocumentException('malformed');
        }
        return $document;
    }
}

if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli') {

    $format = $argv[2] ?? '';

    echo '{"error":"malformed"}';
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

use JobReady\Http\HttpException;
use JobReady\Http\ErrorResponse;
use JobReady\Documents\CvUpload;
use JobReady\Documents\DocumentException;

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');

function jsonResponse(int $status, array $payload): never
{
    http_response_code($status);
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

try {
    require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/config/autoload.php';
    $method = strtoupper($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET');
    $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH) ?: '/';
    // Extraction is independent of interview state, private .env, and AI/observability services.
    if ($path === '/api/cv/extract') {
        if ($method !== 'POST') {
            jsonResponse(405, ['error' => 'Method not allowed.']);
        }
        if (strtolower(trim(explode(';', $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '')[0])) !== 'multipart/form-data') {
            jsonResponse(415, ['error' => 'Upload a PDF or DOCX using multipart/form-data.', 'code' => 'unsupported']);
        }
        try {
            $result = (new CvUpload())->extract($_FILES, (int) ($_SERVER['CONTENT_LENGTH'] ?? 0));
            jsonResponse(200, $result);
        } catch (DocumentException $exception) {
            jsonResponse($exception->status, ['error' => $exception->getMessage(), 'code' => $exception->reason]);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            jsonResponse(503, ['error' => 'Document extraction is unavailable. You can still paste your CV text.', 'code' => 'unavailable']);
        }
    }
    $services = require dirname(__DIR__) . '/config/bootstrap.php';
    if ($method === 'POST' && str_starts_with($path, '/api/interviews')) {
        set_time_limit(65);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/') {
        jsonResponse(200, ['status' => 'ok', 'service' => 'JobReady']);
    }

    if ($path === '/api/dev/status') {
        $enabled = in_array($services['environment'], ['local', 'development'], true)
            && $services['debug'] === true;
        if ($method !== 'GET' || !$enabled) {
            throw new HttpException(404, 'Endpoint not found.');
        }
        // Explicit non-secret fields only; never serialize the environment or service container.
        $model = $services['gemini_model'];
        jsonResponse(200, [
            'APP_ENV' => $services['environment'],
            'debug_enabled' => $services['debug'],
            'AI_PROVIDER' => $services['ai_provider'],
            'GEMINI_MODEL' => preg_match('/^gemini-[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{1,100}$/D', $model) === 1 ? $model : null,
            'diagnostics_enabled' => $enabled,
            'sqlite_driver_available' => in_array('sqlite', PDO::getAvailableDrivers(), true),
        ]);
    }

    $contentType = strtolower(trim(explode(';', $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '')[0]));
    $body = null;
    if ($method === 'POST') {
        if ($contentType !== 'application/json') {
            throw new HttpException(415, 'Content-Type must be application/json.');
        }
        $contentLength = (int) ($_SERVER['CONTENT_LENGTH'] ?? 0);
        if ($contentLength > 50000) {
            throw new HttpException(413, 'Request body exceeds the size limit.');
        }
        $raw = file_get_contents('php://input', false, null, 0, 50001);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) > 50000) {
            throw new HttpException(413, 'Request body exceeds the size limit.');
        }
        try {
            $body = json_decode($raw, true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException) {
            throw new HttpException(400, 'Request body must be valid JSON.');
        }
        if (!is_array($body)) {
            throw new HttpException(400, 'Request body must be a JSON object.');
        }
    }

    if ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/api/interviews') {
        jsonResponse(201, $services['interview_service']->start($body));
    }

    if (preg_match('#^/api/interviews/([a-f0-9-]{36})/answers$#i', $path, $matches)) {
        if ($method !== 'POST') {
            throw new HttpException(405, 'Method not allowed.');
        }
        jsonResponse(200, $services['interview_service']->submitAnswer($matches[1], $body['answer'] ?? null));
    }

    if (preg_match('#^/api/interviews/([a-f0-9-]{36})$#i', $path, $matches)) {
        if ($method !== 'GET') {
            throw new HttpException(405, 'Method not allowed.');
        }
        jsonResponse(200, $services['interview_service']->getProgress($matches[1]));
    }

    throw new HttpException(404, 'Endpoint not found.');
} catch (HttpException $exception) {
    jsonResponse($exception->status, ErrorResponse::fromException(
        $exception,
        $services['environment'] ?? 'production',
        ($services['debug'] ?? false) === true,
    ));
} catch (Throwable $exception) {
    error_log('JobReady request failed: ' . get_class($exception));
    jsonResponse(500, ['error' => 'An internal error occurred.']);
}

## Verdict

**The proposed application files passed the credential scan and offline checks, but Git-ignore coverage needs fixing before a broad commit.** Do not use a blanket `git add .` yet.

No embedded API keys, private tokens, real candidate contact details, or machine-specific user paths were found in the **50 source, template, documentation, and manifest files scanned**. No new credential rotation is indicated by this audit.

## Git inventory and exclusion coverage

- **9 modified tracked files**
- **27 untracked files:** 24 application/test/manifest files and 3 Entire/OpenCode files
- **0 staged files**
- No private environment, runtime, database, log, or document files were found in the tracked-file check.

| Category | Current coverage |
|---|---|
| `.env` and `.env.*` | Ignored; `.env.example` remains intentionally eligible |
| `.env.example` credentials | Placeholders only |
| Root `vendor/` and `node_modules/` | Ignored |
| OpenCode node dependencies and package manifests | Ignored |
| `*.log` | Ignored |
| Default SQLite database and its sidecars | Ignored |
| Entire logs, temporary data, metadata | Ignored by its nested rules |
| Entire/OpenCode folders as a whole | **Not ignored** |
| Upload/temp document directories | **Not ignored** |
| PDFs/DOCX files copied into the repository | **Not generally ignored** |
| JSON/CSV interview exports and alternative database filenames | **Not generally ignored** |
| Extensionless logs and project-local `auth.json` | **Not ignored** |

### Required pre-commit fix

Expand `.gitignore` to cover local runtime/data locations and sensitive document/database artifacts. In particular, exclude `.entire/`, `.opencode/`, `data/`, upload/temp/log directories, raw CV document files, database backups/sidecars, extensionless PHP logs, and project-local credential configuration.

The existing test fixtures are generated from PHP source, so ignoring raw PDF/DOCX artifacts will not prevent committing these tests.

## Document-upload security review

Confirmed controls include:

- Server-side upload-error, extension, actual-format/MIME, and size validation.
- PHP-owned upload-path validation; client MIME declarations are not trusted.
- ZIP path, symlink, encryption, entry-count, size, and compression-ratio checks.
- No archive extraction to filesystem paths.
- DTD/entity rejection and disabled external XML loading.
- Trusted extraction worker with memory, time, decompression, page-count, and output bounds.
- Fixed error messages; parser output and document contents are not logged.
- Temporary-upload deletion in `finally`.

**Success and rejection fixtures left no temporary uploads behind.** I did not inspect your real CV or independently certify the cleanup of that particular past upload.

Also note: deleting the uploaded file does **not** delete extracted CV text already stored in an interview’s SQLite records. That database must remain private and excluded from Git.

## Checks performed

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| All 9 offline PHP suites | Passed |
| All 9 JavaScript tests | Passed |
| All 36 project PHP syntax checks | Passed |
| JavaScript syntax checks | Passed |
| `git diff --check` | Passed |
| `git diff --cached --check` | Passed; nothing staged |
| Composer platform requirements | Passed |
| Composer dependency audit | No known vulnerability advisories |
| Composer manifest validation | Valid; unset project-license warning |

**`composer.json` and `composer.lock` are safe to commit.** They contain normal dependency metadata, with no credential-bearing URLs or custom repositories detected. `vendor/` remains ignored.

## Exact current commit allowlist

These **33 pending application files** are the appropriate commit candidates:

```text
README.md
composer.json
composer.lock
config/autoload.php
config/bootstrap.php
public/app.html
public/index.php
public/assets/answer-draft.mjs
public/assets/app.css

public/assets/jobready.svg
scripts/extract-document.php
src/AI/AIUnavailableException.php
src/AI/GeminiClient.php
src/Documents/CvUpload.php
src/Documents/DocumentException.php
src/Documents/DocumentExtractor.php
src/Documents/ExtractionProcess.php
src/Http/ErrorResponse.php

src/Interview/InterviewService.php
tests/CvUploadFrontendTest.mjs

tests/FrontendTest.mjs
tests/GeminiClientTest.php
tests/GeminiDiagnosticsTest.php

tests/Support/IsolatedHttpServer.php
```

Include the corrected `.gitignore` after an approved fix. Exclude `.entire/`, `.opencode/`, private configuration, databases, exports, logs, uploaded documents, and installed dependencies from this application commit.

## Other quality findings

- **Model-default drift:** `.env.example`, `GeminiClient::DEFAULT_MODEL`, and setup documentation still default to `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, while your confirmed working configuration uses `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`. Align them before sharing the setup with new users.
- **Public-hosting limitation:** session access relies on possession of the UUID, and API rate limiting is absent. This matters before exposing real-CV interviews publicly.
- Unsent answer drafts are intentionally retained in tab-scoped browser storage; they are outside Git, but remain personal data.

No application files were changed or staged. Private `.env`, real CV contents, and interview-record contents were not read. No live provider requests, commits, or pushes were made. Awaiting approval for fixes.

@@ -1,150 +1,150 @@
 # JobReady
 
 An AI-powered adaptive interview preparation agent built for neatHack 2026.
 
 ## What it does
 
 JobReady helps job seekers prepare for interviews using their CV, target job description, and personalised practice sessions.
 
 ## Core features
 
 - Analyse a candidate's CV and job description
 - Generate relevant interview questions
 - Evaluate candidate responses
 - Ask adaptive follow-up questions
 - Track interview progress
 - Produce a personalised readiness report
 
 ## Technology
 
 - PHP 8.2
 - HTML, CSS and JavaScript
 - Gemini API (default), with optional OpenAI provider
 - neatlogs for agent observability
 
 ## Project status
 
 Hackathon development in progress.
 
 ## Local setup
 
 Requirements: PHP 8.2 with `PDO`, `pdo_sqlite`, `curl`, `fileinfo`, `dom`, `zip`, `zlib`, and `iconv` enabled. Confirm the modules with `php -m`. Document extraction also requires an available PHP CLI executable and `proc_open`.
 
 1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and adjust local settings as needed. The example contains placeholders only; credentials belong in `.env` and must not be committed.
 2. Install the locked, lightweight document-parser dependency:
 
    ```sh
    composer install --no-interaction --no-plugins --no-scripts --prefer-dist
    ```
 
 3. Start PHP's built-in server from the repository root, with upload limits sufficient for a 5 MB document and its multipart wrapper:
 
    ```sh
    php -d upload_max_filesize=5M -d post_max_size=6M -d display_errors=0 -S 127.0.0.1:8000 -t public
    ```
 
 4. Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`. The health endpoint returns a JSON status and initializes the SQLite database at `data/jobready.sqlite` on first request. Use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/app.html` for the candidate interface.
 
 ## Candidate interface
 
 Open **`http://127.0.0.1:8000/app.html`** for the JobReady frontend. It is vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with no build step, external fonts, or frontend dependencies. The existing `/` health endpoint and interview APIs are preserved.
 
 The interface includes a preparation brief, adaptive interview workspace, backend-provided focus areas, saved-answer journal, claim evidence reviews when returned, and a completion/readiness report. It distinguishes `probe_answer` follow-ups from new questions. It does not invent evaluation scores, percentage progress, or a fixed question count. All candidate and AI text is rendered with text nodes rather than HTML.
 
 Use **Refresh progress** to load the current saved session, or paste an existing ID into **Already have an interview session?**. The session ID and latest unsent answer draft are remembered in tab-scoped `sessionStorage`; CVs, job descriptions, full answer history, and reports are not persisted in browser storage. Treat the ID as private because the backend currently uses it to access the session. Drafts are bound to the session ID, question decision sequence, and saved-answer count. They survive page reloads in the same tab when browser storage is available, and are cleared once the corresponding saved answer is confirmed or a new session is created. If storage is unavailable, the interface reports that the draft is retained only in memory.
 
 After an uncertain or failed submission, an explicit **Refresh progress** is required before another POST—even after a page reload. Reload restoration performs only a progress GET and never auto-submits a draft. A draft for a changed question is displayed separately for reference rather than inserted into the next answer. There are no automatic POST retries. Existing server sessions and saved answers are not reset by these frontend recovery controls.
 
 Error messages distinguish recognized provider failures such as quota limits, unavailable models, transport failures, and invalid AI output without echoing raw provider messages. A collapsed **Development technical details** section shows only allowlisted category, stage, and upstream HTTP status when the backend supplies development-gated diagnostics. The backend's existing local/development + `APP_DEBUG=true` gate remains authoritative; production responses without metadata do not reveal the section. Credentials, headers, candidate inputs, and raw response bodies are never included. Safe provider/cURL metadata is retained in the frontend error object, not persisted in draft storage.
 
 Controls support keyboard navigation, visible focus, labeled inputs, status announcements, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter for answer submission. The layout adapts to desktop and mobile and respects reduced-motion preferences. The backend must be running on the same origin; do not open `app.html` directly as a local file. Loading the interface does not create an interview. Starting a session or submitting an answer makes real AI calls when credentials are configured.
 
 ### Upload a CV document
 
 Choose or drop one **PDF or modern Word DOCX**, up to **5 MB (5,242,880 bytes)**, in the preparation screen. Paste-text input remains available. Extracted text fills the CV field for review/editing; it is not sent to Gemini until you explicitly start the interview. Failed extraction leaves existing pasted CV text unchanged. Scanned/image-only PDFs require OCR elsewhere or pasted text; this MVP does not run OCR. If extracted text exceeds the existing 20,000-byte interview CV limit, shorten it in the field before starting.
 
 `POST /api/cv/extract` accepts `multipart/form-data` with one `cv_file` and returns `{"text":"...", "format":"pdf"}` (or `docx`). Errors return a fixed `error` message and an allowlisted `code`. Extension, actual bytes/MIME, PHP upload errors, and actual size are checked. This endpoint bypasses private environment loading, interview storage, AI clients, and neatlogs.
 
 PDFs use **smalot/pdfparser 2.12.5**, with its small Symfony mbstring polyfill dependency; versions are locked in `composer.lock`, and `/vendor/` remains Git-ignored. DOCX uses native PHP ZIP/DOM support. Extraction runs in a separate trusted PHP worker with a 96 MB memory limit, eight-second deadline, bounded output, external XML entity loading disabled, and URL/process-execution functions disabled. Uploaded data is parsed, never executed. PDF decompression and page counts are bounded; encrypted files are refused. DOCX packages are never unpacked to disk: unsafe paths, symlinks, encrypted entries, embedded objects/macros, excessive entry counts/sizes, high compression ratios, DTDs/entities, and malformed XML/packages are rejected. Readable output is capped at 64,000 bytes; overly complex documents receive a clear error.
 
 The PHP-owned temporary upload is removed on success or rejection; uploaded files are not permanently stored or written to SQLite. Keep the extraction worker and `vendor/` outside the public web root. No Poppler, Word, OCR service, frontend dependency, or build tool is required. Restart an existing development server using the upload-limit command above; PHP's default upload limit may be below 5 MB. If the dependency or worker is unavailable, paste-text preparation remains usable.
 
 Interview workflow data (including candidate-provided CV, job description, and answers) is stored in SQLite. AI credentials are read server-side and never sent to the browser. Model calls use bounded inputs, timeouts, and structured JSON validation. Candidate text is treated as untrusted content, and raw candidate data is not written to application logs or observability events.
 
 ### AI provider setup
 
 Configure these values privately in `.env` (preserve your existing private key):
 
 ```dotenv
 AI_PROVIDER=gemini
 REDACTED
-GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash-lite
+GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.1-flash-lite
 ```
 
-Gemini is the default when `AI_PROVIDER` is absent. The client uses Google's [official REST generateContent API](https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content), with the key in the `x-goog-api-key` header and JSON response mode. The selected model is Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, which has offered free-tier text usage, subject to your account's quota, region, and current [model availability](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models) and [pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing). Verify availability for your account before a live test; free-tier quota is not guaranteed. Set `GEMINI_MODEL` to another compatible JSON-capable Gemini text model if needed.
+Gemini is the default when `AI_PROVIDER` is absent. The client uses Google's [official REST generateContent API](https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content), with the key in the `x-goog-api-key` header and JSON response mode. The default model is **Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (`gemini-3.1-flash-lite`)**, validated with JobReady's live interview workflow. Access, pricing, and any free-tier allowance depend on your account's quota, region, and current [model availability](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models) and [pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing). Verify availability for your account before a live test; free-tier quota is not guaranteed. Set `GEMINI_MODEL` to another compatible JSON-capable Gemini text model if needed.
 
 Use `AI_PROVIDER=openai` with `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_MODEL` to select the existing OpenAI client. Unsupported provider names fail configuration. Existing process environment variables take precedence over `.env`, so restart the PHP server after changing configuration and check for stale exported settings.
 
 Gemini timeouts, quota/rate-limit errors, safety blocks, and malformed/truncated output fail safely. Failed interview turns roll back and leave the previous question available for retry; there are no automatic provider retries or fallbacks. The existing PHP action/tool validator still determines which decisions can execute. Merely loading bootstrap or the health endpoint makes no AI request; starting an interview or submitting an answer does.
 
 #### Safe development diagnostics
 
 To diagnose an explicitly approved local AI test, set these non-secret values in your private `.env` yourself and restart the PHP server:
 
 ```dotenv
 APP_ENV=local
 APP_DEBUG=true
 ```
 
 Diagnostics are exposed only when `APP_ENV` is exactly `local` or `development` **and** `APP_DEBUG=true`. Other environments, or debug disabled, retain the existing generic error response. Restore `APP_DEBUG=false` after local diagnosis. Existing exported process settings take precedence over `.env`.
 
 Failed AI requests can include an allowlisted `diagnostics` object containing `provider`, `category`, `stage` (`plan`, `decision`, or `claim_verification`), and, when known, `upstream_http_status`, numeric `curl_error_code`, `provider_code`, or a fixed `reason`. Categories distinguish configuration, authentication, authorization, invalid request, model availability, quota/rate limits, provider availability, transport, and invalid output. PHP plan/action/evaluation validation errors retain HTTP 502 while identifying invalid output. Diagnostic metadata never includes credentials, URLs, headers, free-form provider messages, raw response bodies, prompts, or candidate text; no raw error body is logged. HTTP-based categories indicate the failure class, not definitive proof of the responsible service (for example, an intermediary can also return HTTP 403).
 
 Temporary runtime probe: `GET /api/dev/status` is available only with the same exact local/development and debug gate; otherwise it returns HTTP 404. It reports exactly `APP_ENV`, `debug_enabled`, `AI_PROVIDER`, `GEMINI_MODEL`, `diagnostics_enabled`, and `sqlite_driver_available`. Provider/model values use the effective configuration and defaults; malformed model names are reported as `null` rather than echoed. It exposes no keys, database paths, environment-file contents, or candidate data, and makes no AI or neatlogs requests. Inspect `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/dev/status` before another approved live interview test.
 
 neatlogs uses the documented [`POST /v1/trace` HTTP ingest contract](https://docs.neatlogs.com/sdk/http-injection). Configure `NEATLOGS_WRITE_KEY` and `NEATLOGS_PROJECT` in `.env`; the key is read only by PHP and is never returned to the browser. When either value is absent, tracing is a no-op. Transport and HTTP failures are handled without interrupting JobReady, and error logs contain no token, payload, or response body.
 
 ## Interview API (JSON)
 
 - `POST /api/interviews` — start an individualized session. JSON body: `{"cv_text":"...", "job_description":"...", "target_role":"..."}`. Returns the session ID, generated plan, and first question.
 - `POST /api/interviews/{id}/answers` — submit a response. JSON body: `{"answer":"..."}`. The agent evaluates context and chooses its next action; it may ask a new question, probe the answer, verify a claim against supplied evidence, or finish.
 - `GET /api/interviews/{id}` — retrieve progress, questions, answers, decisions, evaluations, and any current question. CV and job-description fields are not returned.
 
 Requests must use `Content-Type: application/json`. CV text is limited to 20 KB, job descriptions to 16 KB, role names to 200 bytes, answers to 8 KB, and interviews to 20 submitted answers. Agent decisions are bounded to three per API turn.
 
 Run all offline tests:
 
 ```sh
 php tests/InterviewWorkflowTest.php
 php tests/GeminiClientTest.php
 php tests/GeminiDiagnosticsTest.php
 php tests/DevStatusEndpointTest.php
 php tests/HealthEndpointTest.php
 php tests/InterviewConnectivityTest.php
 php tests/FrontendHttpTest.php
 php tests/DocumentExtractionTest.php
 php tests/CvUploadHttpTest.php
 node --test tests/FrontendTest.mjs tests/CvUploadFrontendTest.mjs
 ```
 
 These use fake model/HTTP responses and SQLite in-memory databases. They do not load private `.env` or make Gemini, OpenAI, or neatlogs requests. The Gemini tests cover response parsing, request shape, invalid responses/actions, adaptive workflow compatibility, quota/timeouts, and transactional recovery.
 
 The frontend JavaScript tests use Node.js 20+ built-in testing tools (development only, no packages). They verify the PHP response contract, UTF-8 input limits, exact API paths, request timeouts, no automatic retries, allowlisted error diagnostics, production fallback messages, text-only rendering, follow-up display, tab-scoped draft persistence, page-reload recovery, submission guards, and completion reports with fake DOM/fetch fixtures. The frontend HTTP test checks HTML/assets/module MIME types on an isolated PHP server and verifies the health endpoint remains unchanged.
 
 Document tests generate fictional PDF/DOCX fixtures in temporary directories. They cover readable/Unicode text, scanned PDFs, encryption, format spoofing, malformed documents/XML, upload errors and size limits, archive traversal/symlinks/macros, compression bombs, entity rejection, real multipart extraction, and prompt temporary-file cleanup. No private `.env` or personal documents are used, and no provider requests are made.
 
 The diagnostics suite also uses credential-free isolated PHP servers to verify the actual API exposure gate. Its valid fictional requests fail on the fixture's missing key before any external request; it covers generic production responses and development-only metadata.
 
 Run the local HTTP health test with `php tests/HealthEndpointTest.php`. It starts an isolated PHP server on a temporary loopback port, asserts that `GET /` returns HTTP 200 and JSON containing `status: "ok"` and `service: "JobReady"`, and cleans up afterward. It uses a disposable application copy, credential-free environment fixture, and temporary SQLite database; it does not read your private `.env` or contact any external API. PHP `proc_open` and the existing cURL extension must be available.
 
 Run `php tests/InterviewConnectivityTest.php` to check the interview API route without AI calls. It posts an empty JSON object to `/api/interviews` and expects HTTP 422 with a structured missing-field error, then checks malformed JSON returns HTTP 400. Both HTTP tests share the same isolated-server helper and require no existing development server. A pass establishes local routing/validation connectivity in the fixture, not Gemini availability or the state of your separate running server. Failure output includes only a fixed diagnostic phase.
 
 ### Explicit neatlogs integration test
 
 The development test submits exactly one minimal trace named `jobready.integration_test` and contains no candidate data. It is **not sent automatically**. After setting a valid write key and project in your local `.env`, explicitly approve sending by running:
 
 ```sh
 php scripts/test-neatlogs.php --send
 ```
 
 The script refuses to run outside `APP_ENV=local` or `APP_ENV=development`. Running it without `--send` does not send anything. The neatlogs write key must remain private and must never be pasted into source files, browser tools, logs, or screenshots. The application remains framework-free; Composer dependencies are limited to local PDF parsing.

I approve the pre-commit fixes identified in your JobReady security audit.
Implement only these changes:

1. Strengthen the root .gitignore to exclude:
   - .entire/ and .opencode/
   - Local runtime data and SQLite databases, including backup and sidecar files
   - Uploaded CV documents and temporary upload directories
   - Local logs and debug output
   - Private credential/configuration files such as auth.json
   - Sensitive interview export files

2. Ensure the ignore rules do not accidentally exclude application source code, README.md, composer.json, composer.lock, or PHP/JavaScript test fixtures.

3. Update the non-secret default Gemini model from gemini-2.5-flash-lite to gemini-3.1-flash-lite in:
   - .env.example
   - GeminiClient::DEFAULT_MODEL
   - Relevant README setup instructions

4. Update any offline tests that explicitly depend on the previous default model, without weakening their assertions.

5. Run all PHP and JavaScript tests, syntax checks, composer validation, and git diff --check.

6. Verify that .env, installed dependencies, local data, uploaded documents, runtime logs, and Entire/OpenCode folders are excluded from Git.

7. Report changed files, test results, and any remaining risks.

Important:
- Do not read, display, or modify my private .env file.
- Do not read or expose my uploaded CV or interview records.
- Do not delete any existing files or directories.
- Do not make external API requests.

display.text:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require __DIR__ . '/Support/IsolatedHttpServer.php';

function statusCheck(bool $condition, string $message): void
{
    if (!$condition) {
        throw new RuntimeException($message);
    }
}

foreach ([['local', true, true], ['development', true, true], ['local', false, false],
    ['development', false, false], ['production', true, false], ['production', false, false],
    ['staging', true, false]] as [$env, $debug, $allowed]) {
    $server = new IsolatedHttpServer($env, $debug);
    try {
        $response = $server->request('GET', '/api/dev/status');
        statusCheck($response['status'] === ($allowed ? 200 : 404), 'Development status access gate failed.');
        if ($allowed) {
            statusCheck($response['json'] === [
                'APP_ENV' => $env,
                'debug_enabled' => true,
                'AI_PROVIDER' => 'gemini',
                'GEMINI_MODEL' => 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite',
                'diagnostics_enabled' => true,
                'sqlite_driver_available' => true,
            ], 'Status fields, values, or types were incorrect; unexpected fields must not escape.');
        } else {
            statusCheck($response['json'] === ['error' => 'Endpoint not found.'], 'Denied response exposed runtime details.');
        }
    } finally {
        $server->stop();
    }
}

// Alter only the disposable fixture, never the repository's private .env.
foreach ([['APP_DEBUG', 'TRUE'], ['APP_DEBUG', '1'], ['APP_ENV', 'LOCAL'], ['APP_ENV', 'local # comment']] as [$key, $value]) {
    $server = new IsolatedHttpServer('local', true);
    try {
        $fixture = (new ReflectionProperty($server, 'fixture'))->getValue($server);
        $file = $fixture . '/.env';
        $contents = file_get_contents($file);
        $contents = preg_replace('/^' . $key . '=.*$/m', $key . '=' . $value, $contents);
        statusCheck(file_put_contents($file, $contents) !== false, 'Cannot update disposable fixture.');
        $response = $server->request('GET', '/api/dev/status');
        statusCheck($response['status'] === 404 && $response['json'] === ['error' => 'Endpoint not found.'], 'Non-exact development settings enabled status.');
    } finally {
        $server->stop();
    }
}

$server = new IsolatedHttpServer('local', true);
try {
    $fixture = (new ReflectionProperty($server, 'fixture'))->getValue($server);
    // Fixture-only settings verify reporting uses effective configuration, not constants.
    file_put_contents($fixture . '/.env', "APP_ENV=local\nAPP_DEBUG=true\nAPP_DB_PATH=data/test.sqlite\nAI_PROVIDER=openai\nGEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash\nGEMINI_API_KEY=\nOPENAI_API_KEY=\nNEATLOGS_WRITE_KEY=\n");
    $response = $server->request('GET', '/api/dev/status');
    statusCheck($response['status'] === 200 && $response['json']['AI_PROVIDER'] === 'openai'
        && $response['json']['GEMINI_MODEL'] === 'gemini-2.5-flash', 'Status did not report selected configuration.');
    statusCheck(count($response['json']) === 6, 'Unexpected runtime data was exposed.');
} finally {
    $server->stop();
}

$server = new IsolatedHttpServer('local', true);
try {
    $fixture = (new ReflectionProperty($server, 'fixture'))->getValue($server);
    file_put_contents($fixture . '/.env', "APP_ENV=local\nAPP_DEBUG=true\nAPP_DB_PATH=data/test.sqlite\nAI_PROVIDER=gemini\nGEMINI_MODEL=SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_MARKER\nGEMINI_API_KEY=\nOPENAI_API_KEY=\nNEATLOGS_WRITE_KEY=\n");
    $response = $server->request('GET', '/api/dev/status');
    statusCheck($response['status'] === 200 && $response['json']['GEMINI_MODEL'] === null,
        'Invalid model configuration was echoed.');
    statusCheck(!str_contains(json_encode($response['json']), 'SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_MARKER'), 'Unrecognized configuration escaped the status response.');
} finally {
    $server->stop();
}

echo "Development status endpoint tests passed (allowed fields, exact access gate, HTTP 404 when disabled).\n";
